KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:22: Named among the ancient things of Shelah's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jashubi-lehem stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jasiel the Mesobaite
Summary: Mighty man of David, called the Mesobaite.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:47: Mighty man of David, called the Mesobaite.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jasiel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jason, Kinsman of Paul
Summary: Jason was a kinsman of Paul who sends greetings in Romans 16. He is listed separately from Jason of Thessalonica, since the letter does not identify them as the same man.
KeyStory: Jason was a kinsman of Paul who sends greetings in Romans 16. He is listed separately from Jason of Thessalonica, since the letter does not identify them as the same man.
LifeLesson: Greetings from kinsmen show how the gospel travelled along family lines.

Name: Jason
Summary: Jason was a believer at Thessalonica who hosted Paul and Silas. When the Jews stirred up the city, the mob dragged Jason before the rulers, accusing him of harbouring men who acted contrary to Caesar, saying there was another king, Jesus. Jason was released on security.
KeyStory: Jason opened his house to Paul and was dragged before the rulers for harbouring another king's men.
LifeLesson: Hospitality can cost a host his standing. Jason paid security for the gospel he had sheltered.

Name: Jathniel
Summary: Fourth son of Meshelemiah the porter.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:2: Fourth son of Meshelemiah the porter.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jathniel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jaziz the Hagerite
Summary: Hagerite over the flocks of the king.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:31: Hagerite over the flocks of the king.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jaziz in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jeaterai
Summary: Son of Zerah in Gershom's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:21: Son of Zerah in Gershom's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeaterai stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jecamiah, Son of Jeconiah
Summary: Son of Jeconiah, named in the post-exilic royal line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:18: Son of Jeconiah, named in the post-exilic royal line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jecamiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jecholiah, Mother of Azariah
Summary: Jecholiah of Jerusalem was the mother of Azariah, also called Uzziah, king of Judah.
KeyStory: Jecholiah, mother of Azariah.
LifeLesson: A long reign began with a Jerusalem mother whose name is all we know.

Name: Jecoliah, of Jerusalem
Summary: Jecoliah of Jerusalem was the mother of Uzziah, who was sixteen when he began to reign fifty-two years.
KeyStory: Uzziah's mother's name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
LifeLesson: A long and strong reign began under a named mother's care.

Name: Jeconiah, Son of Jehoiakim
Summary: Son of Jehoiakim, named in the line carried toward exile.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:16: Son of Jehoiakim, named in the line carried toward exile.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeconiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jeconiah
Summary: Jeconiah (also called Coniah), son of Jehoiakim, reigned three months in Jerusalem before Nebuchadnezzar carried him to Babylon; after thirty-seven years in prison, Evil-merodach lifted up his head, gave him a seat above the other captive kings, and fed him at the king's table for life.
KeyStory: Jeconiah was carried to Babylon with the vessels of the Lord's house, and in the thirty-seventh year of his captivity the new king of Babylon spoke kindly to him and changed his prison garments.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Evil-Merodach, King of Babylon; Jeremiah; King Nebuchadnezzar; Mordecai
LifeLesson: Even a rejected king is not beyond a kindness that ends in a seat at the table.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile; Esther Saves Her People

Name: Jedaiah, Course Head
Summary: Second lot among the divisions of the sons of Aaron.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:7: Second lot among the divisions of the sons of Aaron.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jedaiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jedaiah, Priest of Jerusalem
Summary: Priest dwelling in Jerusalem after the return.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:10: Priest dwelling in Jerusalem after the return.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jedaiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jedaiah, Son of Harumaph
Summary: Son of Harumaph who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall opposite his own house.
KeyStory: Rebuilding the wall
LifeLesson: God's work begins beside one's own door.

Name: Jedaiah, Son of Joiarib
Summary: Son of Joiarib, a priest who dwelt in Jerusalem after the return.
KeyStory: Resettling Jerusalem
LifeLesson: Dwelling in the city is itself a commitment.

Name: Jedaiah, Son of Shimri
Summary: Son of Shimri son of Shemaiah in Simeon's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:37: Son of Shimri son of Shemaiah in Simeon's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jedaiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jedaiah
Summary: Jedaiah was one of the exiles from Babylon who brought silver and gold to Jerusalem for the crowning of Joshua the high priest (Zechariah 6:10, 6:14).
KeyStory: Jedaiah, with Heldai, Tobijah, and Josiah son of Zephaniah, brought gifts from Babylon for the crown placed on Joshua's head.
RelatedPeople: Heldai; Tobijah; Josiah, Son of Zephaniah; Zerubbabel
LifeLesson: Jedaiah's gift is remembered by name. God records the givers, not just the gift.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall

Name: Jediael, Captain of Manasseh
Summary: Captain of the thousands of Manasseh who fell to David at Ziklag.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:20: Captain of the thousands of Manasseh who fell to David at Ziklag.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jediael in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jediael, Son of Benjamin
Summary: Son of Benjamin, named among the sons of Benjamin.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:6: Son of Benjamin, named among the sons of Benjamin.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jediael stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jediael, Son of Meshelemiah
Summary: Second son of Meshelemiah the porter.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:2: Second son of Meshelemiah the porter.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jediael stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jediael, Son of Shimri
Summary: Son of Shimri the Tizite, one of David's mighty men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:45: Son of Shimri the Tizite, one of David's mighty men.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jediael stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jedidah, Mother of Josiah
Summary: Jedidah, daughter of Adaiah of Boscath, was the mother of Josiah, the boy king who purged Judah.
KeyStory: Jedidah, mother of Josiah.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Adaiah, Father of Jedidah
LifeLesson: The mother of the reforming king came from Boscath, not the palace.

Name: Jeduthun
Summary: Jeduthun was a musician named in the titles of Psalms 39, 62, and 77, psalms of waiting, silence, and remembered deliverance.
KeyStory: His psalms counsel quiet trust: waiting silently for God alone, remembering God's wonders of old when the present feels empty.
KeyVerses: Psalm 39:1; Psalm 62:1; 1 Chronicles 16:41; 1 Chronicles 25:1; Nehemiah 11:17; 2 Chronicles 5:12; 2 Chronicles 29:14; 2 Chronicles 35:15
RelatedPeople: Asaph; Heman, Son of Joel; King Josiah
LifeLesson: Jeduthun's music teaches stillness — sometimes the most faithful thing is to wait silently for God rather than speak.

Name: Jehaleleel
Summary: Father of Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:16: Father of Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehaleleel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jehalelel, Father of Azariah
Summary: Jehalelel was the father of Azariah, a Merarite Levite who cleansed the temple under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Jehalelel is named only as the father of Azariah the son of Jehalelel.
LifeLesson: A father's name anchors a Levite in his clan.

Name: Jehdeiah the Meronothite
Summary: Meronothite over the asses of the king.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:30: Meronothite over the asses of the king.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehdeiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jehdeiah
Summary: Son of Shubael son of Amram in the rest of the sons of Levi.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:20: Son of Shubael son of Amram in the rest of the sons of Levi.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehdeiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jehezekel
Summary: Twentieth lot among the divisions of the sons of Aaron.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:16: Twentieth lot among the divisions of the sons of Aaron.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehezekel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jehiah, Doorkeeper
Summary: Doorkeeper for the ark at its bringing up, with Obed-edom.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:24: Doorkeeper for the ark at its bringing up, with Obed-edom.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jehiel, Father of Gibeon
Summary: Father of Gibeon who dwelt at Gibeon, whose wife was Maachah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:29; 1 Chronicles 9:35: Father of Gibeon who dwelt at Gibeon, whose wife was Maachah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehiel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jehiel, Father of Obadiah
Summary: Father of Obadiah, who returned with Ezra, and of Shechaniah, who proposed putting away the foreign wives.
KeyStory: Ezra's return
RelatedPeople: Obadiah, Son of Jehiel; Shechaniah, Son of Jehiel
LifeLesson: One father's sons can take different paths home.

Name: Jehiel, Overseer
Summary: Jehiel was one of the overseers under Cononiah and Shimei over the offerings and tithes, at the commandment of Hezekiah and Azariah ruler of the house of God.
KeyStory: Jehiel was one of the overseers under Cononiah and Shimei over the offerings and tithes, at the commandment of Hezekiah and Azariah ruler of the house of God.
RelatedPeople: Cononiah, the Levite; Shimei, Brother of Cononiah; King Hezekiah; Azariah, Chief Priest
LifeLesson: Many overseers together kept one storehouse honest.

Name: Jehiel, Ruler of the House of God
Role: Ruler of the House of God
Summary: Jehiel, a ruler of the house of God with Hilkiah and Zechariah, gave the priests two thousand six hundred small cattle and three hundred oxen for Josiah's Passover offerings.
KeyStory: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings.
RelatedPeople: Hilkiah, the High Priest; Zechariah, Ruler of the House of God; King Josiah
LifeLesson: Generous rulers made a Passover like none since Samuel possible.

Name: Jehiel, Singer of Second Degree
Summary: Levite of the second degree appointed to sing with psalteries on Alamoth at the bringing up of the ark.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:18; 1 Chronicles 15:20: Levite of the second degree appointed to sing with psalteries on Alamoth at the bringing up of the ark.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehiel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jehiel, Son of Elam
Summary: Son of Elam named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Jehiel, Son of Hachmoni
Summary: Son of Hachmoni, with the king's sons.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:32: Son of Hachmoni, with the king's sons.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehiel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jehiel, Son of Harim
Summary: Son of Harim named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Jehiel, Son of Heman
Summary: Jehiel, of the sons of Heman, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Of the sons of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei arose to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Shimei, Son of Heman; King Hezekiah; Heman, Son of Joel
LifeLesson: Heman's sons cleansed the house their father had sung in.

Name: Jehiel, Son of Hothan
Summary: Son of Hothan the Aroerite, one of David's mighty men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:44: Son of Hothan the Aroerite, one of David's mighty men.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehiel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jehiel, Son of Jehoshaphat
Summary: Jehiel was a son of Jehoshaphat who received great gifts from his father, but the kingdom went to Jehoram the firstborn, who slew all his brethren.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat's sons, including Jehiel, received gifts of silver, gold and precious things with fenced cities, but Jehoram slew them with the sword.
RelatedPeople: King Jehoshaphat; Jehoram, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Gifts from a father could not protect sons from a brother's sword.

Name: Jehiel, Son of Laadan
Summary: Chief son of Laadan, with Zetham and Joel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:8; 1 Chronicles 26:21: Chief son of Laadan, with Zetham and Joel.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehiel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jehiel the Gershonite
Summary: Gershonite by whose hand the precious stones given for the house of God were kept.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 29:8: Gershonite by whose hand the precious stones given for the house of God were kept.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehiel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jehizkiah, Son of Shallum
Summary: Jehizkiah, son of Shallum, was one of the heads of Ephraim who stood up against bringing Judah's captives into Samaria.
KeyStory: Jehizkiah the son of Shallum stood with the other heads against the returning host.
LifeLesson: Refusing to profit from a brother's captivity is itself obedience.

Name: Jehoadah
Summary: Son of Ahaz and father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:36: Son of Ahaz and father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehoadah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jehoaddan, Mother of Amaziah
Summary: Jehoaddan of Jerusalem was the mother of Amaziah king of Judah.
KeyStory: Jehoaddan, mother of Amaziah.
LifeLesson: A Jerusalem mother raised a king who beat Edom and bowed to its gods.

Name: Jehoaddan, of Jerusalem
Summary: Jehoaddan of Jerusalem was the mother of Amaziah, who was twenty-five when he began to reign twenty-nine years.
KeyStory: Amaziah's mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
LifeLesson: A king's mother is named at the start of his reign, for good or ill.

Name: Jehoahaz, King of Israel
Summary: Jehoahaz, son of Jehu, reigned seventeen years, did evil, and was so oppressed by Syria that his army was left like dust to be threshed, until he besought the LORD and God gave Israel a saviour.
KeyStory: Jehoahaz oppressed by Syria prays, and God answers.
RelatedPeople: Jehu, King of Israel; Hazael, King of Syria; Ben-Hadad III, King of Syria; Jehoash, King of Israel
LifeLesson: Even a king who did evil found that prayer still reached God.

Name: Jehoahaz, King of Judah
Summary: Jehoahaz, son of Josiah, reigned three months in Jerusalem, did evil, and was deposed by Pharaoh Necho, who carried him to Egypt where he died.
KeyStory: Jehoahaz deposed after three months and taken to Egypt.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Hamutal, Mother of Jehoahaz and Zedekiah; Zedekiah, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Three months is enough to show a heart: Jehoahaz chose evil and lost the throne his father had honoured.

Name: Jehoahaz, Son of Jehu
Summary: Jehoahaz, son of Jehu and king of Israel, was the father of Joash king of Israel, who defeated Amaziah of Judah.
KeyStory: Amaziah sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, and Joash later took Amaziah at Beth-shemesh.
RelatedPeople: Joash, King of Israel; Jehu, Son of Nimshi
LifeLesson: A dynasty founded in judgment still passed its throne from father to son.

Name: Jehoahaz, Son of Josiah
Summary: Jehoahaz, son of Josiah, was made king by the people of the land, reigned three months in Jerusalem, and was put down by the king of Egypt, who carried him to Egypt and fined the land.
KeyStory: The people took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah and made him king, but Necho took him to Egypt and made his brother Eliakim king.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Necho, King of Egypt
LifeLesson: A three-month reign shows how quickly a kingdom can change hands.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile

Name: Jehoash, King of Israel
Summary: Jehoash, also called Joash, son of Jehoahaz, recovered from Ben-Hadad the cities Syria had taken, visited the dying Elisha, and captured Amaziah of Judah at Beth-shemesh.
KeyStory: Jehoash recovers Israel's cities and captures Amaziah.
RelatedPeople: Jehoahaz, King of Israel; Ben-Hadad III, King of Syria; Amaziah, King of Judah; Jeroboam II, King of Israel
LifeLesson: God gives victories even to imperfect kings, for His people's sake.

Name: Jehohanan, Captain of Judah
Summary: Jehohanan was a captain under Jehoshaphat, next to Adnah, with two hundred and fourscore thousand men.
KeyStory: Next to Adnah was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.

Name: Jehohanan, Father of Ishmael
Summary: Jehohanan was the father of Ishmael, a captain of hundreds in Jehoiada's covenant.
KeyStory: Jehohanan is named only as the father of Ishmael the son of Jehohanan.
LifeLesson: A name in a covenant list is still a share in the story.

Name: Jehohanan, Son of Bebai
Summary: Son of Bebai named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Jehohanan, Son of Meshelemiah
Summary: Sixth son of Meshelemiah the porter.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:3: Sixth son of Meshelemiah the porter.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehohanan stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jehohanan
Summary: A priest of Amariah's course in Joiakim's days, also named among the musicians at the wall's dedication.
KeyStory: Dedication of the wall
LifeLesson: Priests both kept the courses and led the song.

Name: Jehoiachin, King of Judah
Summary: Jehoiachin reigned three months, surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar, and was carried to Babylon with his mother and officers; thirty-seven years later Evil-Merodach released him from prison and set his seat above the other captive kings.
KeyStory: Jehoiachin surrenders and is later released in Babylon.
RelatedPeople: King Nebuchadnezzar; Evil-Merodach, King of Babylon; Nehushta, Mother of Jehoiachin; Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Zedekiah, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Even in exile, God's mercy finds the prisoner: Jehoiachin's release is a small dawn before the return.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile

Name: Jehoiada, Father of Benaiah
Summary: Jehoiada is named as the father of Benaiah, the valiant captain of David's guard who slew lions and giants.
KeyStory: Jehoiada's son became the most feared warrior of David's guard.
LifeLesson: A father's name is honoured by a son's valour.

Name: Jehoiada, High Priest
Summary: Jehoiada the priest, husband of Jehosheba, hid Joash six years, crowned him at seven, slew Athaliah, and instructed the king all his days.
KeyStory: Jehoiada crowns Joash and purges Baal.
RelatedPeople: Joash, King of Judah; Jehosheba, Daughter of Jehoram; Athaliah; Mattan, Priest of Baal
LifeLesson: One priest's six hidden years saved the house of David.

Name: Jehoiada, Leader of Aaronites
Summary: Leader of the Aaronites who came to David at Hebron, with three thousand and seven hundred with him.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:27: Leader of the Aaronites who came to David at Hebron, with three thousand and seven hundred with him.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehoiada in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jehoiada, Son of Benaiah
Summary: Son of Benaiah, counsellor after Ahithophel, with Abiathar.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:34: Son of Benaiah, counsellor after Ahithophel, with Abiathar.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehoiada stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jehoiada, Son of Paseah
Summary: Son of Paseah who with Meshullam repaired the old gate of Jerusalem's wall.
KeyStory: Rebuilding the wall
LifeLesson: Old gates are repaired by new hands.

Name: Jehoiada, the Priest
Summary: Jehoiada the priest hid Joash six years, took the captains of hundreds into covenant, crowned the boy king, had Athaliah slain, made a covenant that the people should be the LORD's, restored temple worship, and died at 130, buried among the kings for the good he had done.
KeyStory: In the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, brought out the king's son, crowned and anointed him, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.
RelatedPeople: Joash, King of Judah; Jehoshabeath, Daughter of Jehoram; Zechariah, Son of Jehoiada
LifeLesson: One priest's long faithfulness can preserve a nation and a promise.

Name: Jehoiakim, King of Judah
Summary: Jehoiakim, born Eliakim, was set on the throne by Pharaoh Necho, taxed Judah to pay Egypt, served Nebuchadnezzar three years and then rebelled, and died as Babylon closed in.
KeyStory: Jehoiakim taxes Judah, serves Babylon, then rebels.
KeyVerses: 2 Kings 23:36; 2 Kings 24:1; 2 Kings 24:6; 2 Chronicles 36:4; 2 Chronicles 36:5; 2 Chronicles 36:6; Jeremiah 22:18-19; Jeremiah 26:21-23; Jeremiah 36:23; Jeremiah 36:28-31
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Zebudah, Mother of Jehoiakim; King Nebuchadnezzar; Jehoiachin, King of Judah; Jehoahaz, Son of Josiah; Jeconiah; Jeremiah; Urijah, Son of Shemaiah; Jehudi
LifeLesson: A king who taxes God's people to pay foreign masters has already surrendered.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile

Name: Jehoiakim, Son of Josiah
Summary: Second son of Josiah in the kingly line of Judah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:15: Second son of Josiah in the kingly line of Judah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehoiakim stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jehoiarib, Course Head
Summary: First lot among the divisions of the sons of Aaron.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:7: First lot among the divisions of the sons of Aaron.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehoiarib in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jehoiarib, Priest of Jerusalem
Summary: Priest dwelling in Jerusalem after the return.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:10: Priest dwelling in Jerusalem after the return.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehoiarib in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jehonadab, Son of Rechab
Summary: Jehonadab, son of Rechab, met Jehu on the road, gave him his hand, rode with him to Samaria, and witnessed Jehu's purge of Baal's worshippers.
KeyStory: Jehonadab rides with Jehu against Baal.
RelatedPeople: Jehu, King of Israel; Rechab, Father of Jehonadab
LifeLesson: A man of the desert can steady a king's zeal, and also see where it stops.

Name: Jehonathan, Son of Uzziah
Summary: Son of Uzziah, over the storehouses in the fields, cities, villages, and castles.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:25: Son of Uzziah, over the storehouses in the fields, cities, villages, and castles.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehonathan stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jehonathan, the Levite
Summary: Jehonathan was one of the Levites sent with Jehoshaphat's princes to teach the book of the law throughout Judah.
KeyStory: With the princes went Levites, including Jehonathan, teaching the people throughout Judah.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.

Name: Jehonathan
Summary: Priest in the days of Joiakim.
KeyStory: Dedication of the wall
LifeLesson: Courses of priests kept worship ordered across generations.

Name: Jehoram, King of Israel
Summary: Jehoram, also called Joram, son of Ahab, put away Baal's image but clung to Jeroboam's sins, warred with Moab alongside Jehoshaphat, and was slain by Jehu at Jezreel.
KeyStory: Jehoram wars with Moab and is slain by Jehu.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Jezebel; Mesha, King of Moab; King Jehoshaphat; Jehu, King of Israel; Ahaziah, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Half a reform is no reform: Jehoram removed an image and kept the idolatry.

Name: Jehoram, King of Judah
Summary: Jehoram, son of Jehoshaphat and husband of Ahab's daughter Athaliah, walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, killed his brothers, and lost Edom and Libnah to revolt.
KeyStory: Jehoram's wicked reign and Edom's revolt.
KeyVerses: 2 Kings 8:16; 2 Kings 8:21; 2 Chronicles 21:1; 2 Chronicles 21:4; 2 Chronicles 21:12; 2 Chronicles 21:18
RelatedPeople: King Jehoshaphat; Athaliah; Ahaziah, King of Judah; Elijah
LifeLesson: Marriage alliances shape a legacy: Jehoram imported Ahab's house into Judah, and Judah paid for it.

Name: Jehoram, Son of Ahab
Summary: Jehoram, son of Ahab and king of Israel, also called Joram, was wounded by the Syrians at Ramoth-gilead and was later slain when Jehu, anointed to cut off the house of Ahab, came against him.
KeyStory: Ahaziah went down to see Jehoram son of Ahab at Jezreel because he was sick, and his coming to Joram became the occasion of his destruction by Jehu.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Ahaziah, King of Judah; Jehu, Son of Nimshi
LifeLesson: Friendship with an idolatrous house can drag a king to his death.

Name: Jehoram, the Priest
Summary: Jehoram was one of the priests sent with Jehoshaphat's princes and Levites to teach the book of the law, distinct from Jehoram king of Judah.
KeyStory: With the Levites went Elishama and Jehoram, priests, and they taught in Judah.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.

Name: Jehoshabeath, Daughter of Jehoram
Role: Daughter of the King; Wife of Jehoiada
Summary: Jehoshabeath, daughter of King Jehoram and wife of Jehoiada the priest, stole the baby Joash from among the king's sons being slain and hid him and his nurse in a bedchamber from Athaliah.
KeyStory: Jehoshabeath, sister of Ahaziah, hid Joash in the house of God six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.
RelatedPeople: Jehoram, King of Judah; Jehoiada, the Priest; Joash, King of Judah
LifeLesson: One woman's courage preserved David's line and the promise with it.

Name: Jehoshaphat, Priest of the Ark
Summary: Priest who blew with the trumpet before the ark of God.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:24: Priest who blew with the trumpet before the ark of God.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehoshaphat in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jehoshaphat, Son of Ahilud
Summary: Jehoshaphat, son of Ahilud, was David's recorder — the officer who kept the chronicles of the reign — through David's administration and into the revolt of Sheba.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat kept the chronicle of David's reign from its height through its civil wars.
RelatedPeople: King David; Ahilud, Father of Jehoshaphat; Joab; King Solomon; Ahilud, Father of Jehoshaphat the Recorder
LifeLesson: Someone must write the chronicle, even the chapters the king would rather forget.

Name: Jehoshaphat, Son of Nimshi
Summary: Jehoshaphat, son of Nimshi, was the father of Jehu king of Israel, through whom Jehu is named son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat, father of Jehu.
RelatedPeople: Jehu, King of Israel; Nimshi, Grandfather of Jehu
LifeLesson: A father's name carried into a son's anointing is a quiet legacy.

Name: Jehoshaphat, Son of Paruah
Summary: Jehoshaphat, son of Paruah, was one of Solomon's twelve officers, over Issachar.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat, officer over Issachar.
RelatedPeople: King Solomon; Paruah, Father of Jehoshaphat the Officer
LifeLesson: Three Jehoshaphats serve in Kings; only the offices tell them apart.

Name: Jehosheba, Daughter of Jehoram
Summary: Jehosheba, daughter of King Jehoram and sister of Ahaziah, stole the baby Joash from among the king's sons being slain and hid him with his nurse in the temple six years.
KeyStory: Jehosheba hides baby Joash from Athaliah.
RelatedPeople: Jehoram, King of Judah; Ahaziah, King of Judah; Joash, King of Judah; Jehoiada, High Priest
LifeLesson: One woman's courage kept David's lamp burning through Athaliah's purge.

Name: Jehoshua, Son of Non
Summary: Son of Non in Ephraim's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:27: Son of Non in Ephraim's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehoshua stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jehozabad, Captain of Benjamin
Summary: Jehozabad of Benjamin commanded a hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for war under Jehoshaphat.
KeyStory: Next to Eliada was Jehozabad, and with him a hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.

Name: Jehozabad, Son of Obed-edom
Summary: Second son of Obed-edom the porter.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:4: Second son of Obed-edom the porter.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehozabad stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jehozabad, Son of Shimrith
Summary: Jehozabad, son of Shimrith a Moabitess, was one of the servants who conspired against Joash and slew him on his bed.
KeyStory: Jehozabad the son of Shimrith joined Zabad in conspiring against Joash for the blood of Jehoiada's sons.
RelatedPeople: Joash, King of Judah; Shimrith, the Moabitess
LifeLesson: Those who avenge innocent blood can themselves become murderers.

Name: Jehozabad, Son of Shomer
Summary: Jehozabad, son of Shomer, with Jozachar, conspired and slew King Joash in the house of Millo.
KeyStory: Jehozabad slays Joash.
RelatedPeople: Joash, King of Judah; Shomer, Mother of Jehozabad; Jozachar, Son of Shimeath
LifeLesson: Conspiracy in the household ends a reign that idolatry had already emptied.

Name: Jehozadak
Role: Father of Joshua the High Priest
Summary: Jehozadak (KJV 'Josedech' in Haggai) is named as the father of Joshua the high priest (Haggai 1:1). He was the high priest carried into Babylonian exile, so his son Joshua served as high priest of the return without his father beside him.
KeyStory: Jehozadak, the exiled high priest, is named as the father of Joshua, who served as high priest when the exiles returned and rebuilt.
RelatedPeople: Joshua, Son of Jehozadak; Seraiah, Son of Azariah
LifeLesson: Jehozadak went into exile and never came home — but his son rebuilt. Sometimes the greatest service is a son raised for a day the father never sees.

Name: Jehu, King of Israel
Summary: Jehu, son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, was anointed by Elisha's prophet, rode furiously to Jezreel, slew Jehoram and Jezebel, wiped out Ahab's house and Baal's worshippers, yet kept Jeroboam's calves.
KeyStory: Jehu anointed, slays Jehoram and Jezebel, and purges Baal.
RelatedPeople: Jehoram, King of Israel; Jezebel; Jehoshaphat, Son of Nimshi; Jehonadab, Son of Rechab; Jehoahaz, King of Israel; Hosea
LifeLesson: Zeal that purges others' sins but keeps its own is zeal half-finished.

Name: Jehu, Son of Hanani
Summary: Jehu the son of Hanani brought the LORD's word against Baasha, that his house would be made like Jeroboam's, because he walked in Jeroboam's sins after God raised him from the dust.
KeyStory: Jehu prophesies against Baasha's house.
RelatedPeople: Baasha, King of Israel; Hanani, Father of Jehu the Prophet; Hanani, the Seer; King Jehoshaphat
LifeLesson: The prophet who judges one dynasty is not spared the duty of judging the next.

Name: Jehu, Son of Josibiah
Summary: Son of Josibiah son of Seraiah son of Asiel, prince of Simeon.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:35: Son of Josibiah son of Seraiah son of Asiel, prince of Simeon.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehu stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jehu, Son of Nimshi
Summary: Jehu, son of Nimshi, was anointed by the LORD to cut off the house of Ahab; executing that judgment, he slew the princes of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah's brethren, and then slew Ahaziah himself.
KeyStory: When Jehu executed judgment upon the house of Ahab, he found Judah's princes ministering to Ahaziah and slew them, then sought and slew Ahaziah.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Ahaziah, King of Judah
LifeLesson: God's judgment on one house can sweep up its allies as well.

Name: Jehu, Son of Obed
Summary: Son of Obed and father of Azariah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:38: Son of Obed and father of Azariah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehu stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jehu the Antothite
Summary: One of those who came to David at Ziklag, called the Antothite.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:3: One of those who came to David at Ziklag, called the Antothite.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehu in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jehubbah
Summary: Son of Shamer in Asher's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:34: Son of Shamer in Asher's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehubbah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jehucal
Summary: Jehucal (also spelled Jucal), son of Shelemiah, was a prince whom Zedekiah twice sent to Jeremiah — once to ask him to pray for the city, and once among those demanding his death.
KeyStory: Zedekiah sent Jehucal to ask Jeremiah to pray to the Lord for them, yet Jehucal later joined the princes who said Jeremiah should die.
LifeLesson: The same messenger can carry a prayer request one day and a death sentence the next.

Name: Jehudi
Summary: Jehudi, son of Nethaniah, was the court official sent to fetch Jeremiah's roll from Elishama's chamber and read it to Jehoiakim, who cut it up and burned it column by column.
KeyStory: Jehudi read the roll in the king's ears in the winter house, and as he read each column, Jehoiakim cut it with a penknife and cast it into the fire.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Jeremiah; Baruch
LifeLesson: Reading God's word aloud to power is faithful even when power answers with a knife and a fire.

Name: Jehudijah
Summary: Wife of Mered who bore Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:18: Wife of Mered who bore Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehudijah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jehush
Summary: Second son of Eshek, named in Benjamin's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:39: Second son of Eshek, named in Benjamin's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehush stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jeiel, Chief of the Levites
Summary: Jeiel, a chief of the Levites, gave with Cononiah and the other chiefs five thousand small cattle and five hundred oxen for Josiah's Passover.
KeyStory: Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings.
RelatedPeople: Cononiah, Chief of the Levites; King Josiah
LifeLesson: Levite chiefs supplied their brethren's offerings.

Name: Jeiel, of Adonikam's Sons
Summary: One of the last sons of Adonikam who returned with Ezra (Ezra 8:13).
KeyStory: Ezra's return
LifeLesson: God's company includes latecomers as well as firstcomers.

Name: Jeiel, of the Sons of Elizaphan
Summary: Jeiel, of the sons of Elizaphan, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel arose to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Shimri, of the Sons of Elizaphan; King Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Two men of one clan stood together for a clean temple.

Name: Jeiel, Porter
Summary: Levite porter appointed at the bringing up of the ark, with psalteries and harps.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:18; 1 Chronicles 15:21; 1 Chronicles 16:5: Levite porter appointed at the bringing up of the ark, with psalteries and harps.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeiel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jeiel, Prince of Reuben
Summary: Chief among the brethren of Reuben when their genealogy was reckoned.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:7: Chief among the brethren of Reuben when their genealogy was reckoned.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeiel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jeiel, Son of Mattaniah
Role: Levite of the Sons of Asaph
Summary: Jeiel, son of Mattaniah, was an ancestor of Jahaziel the Levite upon whom the Spirit came before Jehoshaphat's army.
KeyStory: Jeiel stands in Jahaziel's line: son of Mattaniah, father of Benaiah.
RelatedPeople: Jahaziel, Son of Zechariah; Mattaniah, Ancestor of Jahaziel
LifeLesson: Generations of worship prepared the ground for a word in a crisis.

Name: Jeiel, Son of Nebo
Summary: Son of Nebo named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Jeiel, the Scribe
Summary: Jeiel the scribe, with Maaseiah the ruler under Hananiah, numbered Uzziah's host of fighting men by bands for war.
KeyStory: Uzziah's army went out by bands according to their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler.
RelatedPeople: Uzziah, King of Judah; Maaseiah, the Ruler
LifeLesson: Even counting an army is service to the king and the kingdom.

Name: Jekameam
Summary: Fourth son of Hebron in David's divisions.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:19; 1 Chronicles 24:23: Fourth son of Hebron in David's divisions.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jekameam stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jekamiah
Summary: Son of Shallum and father of Elishama.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:41: Son of Shallum and father of Elishama.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jekamiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jekuthiel
Summary: Son of Mered by Jehudijah, called the father of Zanoah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:18: Son of Mered by Jehudijah, called the father of Zanoah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jekuthiel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jemima
Summary: Jemima was Job's eldest daughter after his restoration, named in Job 42 among the three daughters born when God restored Job's fortunes twofold.
KeyStory: After Job's suffering, God gave him seven more sons and three daughters; Jemima, Kezia, and Keren-happuch were said to be the fairest women in all the land, and Job gave them an inheritance among their brothers.
LifeLesson: Jemima's story is part of Job's restoration — God does not merely replace what was lost, He honours what follows suffering.

Name: Jephthah, Judge of Israel
Summary: Jephthah the Gileadite, son of Gilead, was driven out by his half-brothers, recalled to lead Israel against Ammon, defeated Ammon, and kept the rash vow that cost his only daughter; he judged Israel six years.
KeyStory: Cast out as the son of a harlot, Jephthah was fetched back by the elders of Gilead, reasoned with the king of Ammon from Israel's history, vowed whatever came from his house if God gave him victory, and, when his daughter came out dancing, did with her according to his vow; he judged Israel six years.
LifeLesson: A vow made in battle's heat can cost more than the battle was worth.

Name: Jephunneh, Son of Jether
Summary: Son of Jether in Asher's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:38: Son of Jether in Asher's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jephunneh stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jerahmeel, Son of Kish
Summary: Son of Kish in the rest of the sons of Levi.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:29: Son of Kish in the rest of the sons of Levi.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jerahmeel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jerahmeel
Summary: Jerahmeel, son of Hammelech, was sent by Jehoiakim with Seraiah and Shelemiah to seize Jeremiah and Baruch after the scroll was burned, but the Lord hid them.
KeyStory: The king commanded Jerahmeel to take Jeremiah and Baruch, but the Lord hid them from the king's men.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Jeremiah; Baruch; Hezron, Son of Pharez
LifeLesson: A king's arrest warrant is no match for God's hiding place.

Name: Jered, Father of Gedor
Summary: Son of Mered by Jehudijah, called the father of Gedor.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:18: Son of Mered by Jehudijah, called the father of Gedor.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jered stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jeremai, Son of Hashum
Summary: Son of Hashum named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Jeremiah, Captain of Gad
Summary: Fifth captain of the Gadites who separated themselves to David in the wilderness.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:10: Fifth captain of the Gadites who separated themselves to David in the wilderness.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeremiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jeremiah, Father of Hamutal
Summary: Jeremiah of Libnah was the father of Hamutal, mother of Jehoahaz and Zedekiah; he is distinct from Jeremiah the prophet.
KeyStory: Jeremiah, father of Hamutal.
RelatedPeople: Hamutal, Mother of Jehoahaz and Zedekiah
LifeLesson: A name on a list is still a life God knew.

Name: Jeremiah, Head of Manasseh
Summary: Head of the house of Manasseh's fathers, a mighty man of valour.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:24: Head of the house of Manasseh's fathers, a mighty man of valour.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeremiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jeremiah, Second Captain of Gad
Summary: Tenth captain of the Gadites who separated themselves to David in the wilderness.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:13: Tenth captain of the Gadites who separated themselves to David in the wilderness.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeremiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jeremiah, Son of Ziklag Band
Summary: One of those who came to David at Ziklag.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:4: One of those who came to David at Ziklag.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeremiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jeremiah the Musician
Summary: Musician in the procession at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall (Nehemiah 12:34). Not Jeremiah the prophet.
KeyStory: Dedication of the wall
LifeLesson: A shared name does not make a shared life.

Name: Jeremiah the Priest
Summary: Priest who sealed the covenant (Nehemiah 10:2) and returned with Zerubbabel and Jeshua (Nehemiah 12:1); the course of Jeremiah in Joiakim's days bears his name (Nehemiah 12:12). Not Jeremiah the prophet.
KeyStory: Covenant renewal
LifeLesson: A priest's name can span the return, the covenant, and the courses.

Name: Jeremoth, Son of Beriah
Summary: Named among the sons of Beriah in Benjamin's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:14: Named among the sons of Beriah in Benjamin's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeremoth stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jeremoth, Son of Elam
Summary: Son of Elam named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Jeremoth, Son of Mushi
Summary: Son of Mushi, named among the sons of Mushi.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:23: Son of Mushi, named among the sons of Mushi.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeremoth stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jeremoth, Son of Zattu
Summary: Son of Zattu named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Jeriah, Son of Hebron
Summary: First son of Hebron in David's divisions.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:19; 1 Chronicles 24:23: First son of Hebron in David's divisions.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeriah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jeribai, Son of Elnaam
Summary: Son of Elnaam, one of David's mighty men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:46: Son of Elnaam, one of David's mighty men.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeribai stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jeriel
Summary: Son of Tola and head of his father's house, a valiant man of might.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:2: Son of Tola and head of his father's house, a valiant man of might.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeriel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jerijah, Chief of Hebron
Summary: Chief among the Hebronites, sought in the fortieth year of David's reign.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:31: Chief among the Hebronites, sought in the fortieth year of David's reign.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jerijah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jerimoth, Overseer
Summary: Jerimoth was one of the overseers under Cononiah and Shimei over the offerings and tithes under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Jerimoth was one of the overseers under Cononiah and Shimei over the offerings and tithes under Hezekiah.
RelatedPeople: Cononiah, the Levite; Shimei, Brother of Cononiah; King Hezekiah; Azariah, Chief Priest
LifeLesson: Many overseers together kept one storehouse honest.

Name: Jerimoth, Son of Azriel
Summary: Son of Azriel, ruler of Naphtali.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:19: Son of Azriel, ruler of Naphtali.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jerimoth stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jerimoth, Son of Becher
Summary: Son of Becher, named among the sons of Becher.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:8: Son of Becher, named among the sons of Becher.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jerimoth stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jerimoth, Son of Bela
Summary: Son of Bela and head of his father's house, a mighty man of valour.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:7: Son of Bela and head of his father's house, a mighty man of valour.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jerimoth stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jerimoth, Son of David
Summary: Jerimoth, son of David, was the father of Mahalath, one of Rehoboam's wives.
KeyStory: Rehoboam took Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife.
RelatedPeople: King David; Mahalath, Daughter of Jerimoth
LifeLesson: David's line continued through sons whose names appear only in a marriage record.

Name: Jerimoth, Son of Heman
Summary: Son of Heman the king's seer, fifteenth lot for song.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 25:4; 1 Chronicles 25:22: Son of Heman the king's seer, fifteenth lot for song.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jerimoth stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jerimoth, Son of Ziklag Band
Summary: One of those who came to David at Ziklag.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:5: One of those who came to David at Ziklag.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jerimoth in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jerioth
Summary: Wife of Caleb son of Hezron, named alongside Azubah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:18: Wife of Caleb son of Hezron, named alongside Azubah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jerioth in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jeroboam II, King of Israel
Summary: Jeroboam the second, son of Jehoash, reigned forty-one years and restored Israel's border from Hamath to the Sea of the plain, according to the word of Jonah, though he did not depart from Jeroboam's sins.
KeyStory: Jeroboam II restores Israel's border.
RelatedPeople: Jehoash, King of Israel; Jonah; Zachariah, King of Israel; Amos; Hosea
LifeLesson: Prosperity is not approval: Jeroboam II's victories came with Jeroboam I's sins intact.

Name: Jeroham, Father of Adaiah
Summary: Father of Adaiah the priest, son of Pashur son of Malchijah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:12: Father of Adaiah the priest, son of Pashur son of Malchijah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeroham in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jeroham, Father of Azariah
Summary: Jeroham was the father of Azariah, a captain of hundreds in Jehoiada's covenant.
KeyStory: Jeroham is named only as the father of Azariah the son of Jeroham.
LifeLesson: A captain's father is remembered through his son's stand.

Name: Jeroham, Father of Shamsherai
Summary: Father of Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaresiah, Eliah, and Zichri in Benjamin's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:27: Father of Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaresiah, Eliah, and Zichri in Benjamin's line.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeroham in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jeroham of Gedor
Summary: Father of Joelah and Zebadiah who came to David at Ziklag.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:7: Father of Joelah and Zebadiah who came to David at Ziklag.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeroham in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jeroham, Son of Eliab
Summary: Son of Eliab and father of Elkanah in the Samuel line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:27: Son of Eliab and father of Elkanah in the Samuel line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeroham stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jeroham, Son of Elihu
Summary: Jeroham, son of Elihu, is named as the father of Elkanah, Samuel's father.
KeyStory: Jeroham is the last named link before Elkanah in the genealogy that opens 1 Samuel.
LifeLesson: A father's faithfulness shapes the home a prophet grows up in.

Name: Jeroham, Son of Pelaliah
Summary: Jeroham son of Pelaliah, named in Nehemiah 11:12.
KeyStory: Resettling Jerusalem
LifeLesson: Every person in the record, however briefly named, belongs to God's story.

Name: Jerusha, Mother of Jotham
Summary: Jerusha, daughter of Zadok, was the mother of Jotham king of Judah.
KeyStory: Jerusha, mother of Jotham.
RelatedPeople: Jotham, King of Judah; Uzziah, King of Judah
LifeLesson: A priest's daughter became a king's mother in a leprous king's house.

Name: Jerushah, Daughter of Zadok
Summary: Jerushah, daughter of Zadok, was the mother of Jotham, who was twenty-five when he began to reign sixteen years.
KeyStory: Jotham's mother's name was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.
RelatedPeople: Jotham, King of Judah; Zadok, Father of Jerushah
LifeLesson: A mother's name opens the record of a righteous reign.

Name: Jesaiah, Son of Hananiah
Summary: Son of Hananiah son of Zerubbabel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:21: Son of Hananiah son of Zerubbabel.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jesaiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jesaiah
Summary: Ancestor of Ithiel, in the Benjaminite line of Jerusalem (Nehemiah 11:7).
KeyStory: Resettling Jerusalem
LifeLesson: Every line in the record belongs to God's story.

Name: Jeshaiah, of the Sons of Merari
Summary: A Levite of the sons of Merari brought from Casiphia for the temple service; a different Jeshaiah from Athaliah's son.
KeyStory: Ezra's return
LifeLesson: God provides workers when his people ask.

Name: Jeshaiah, Son of Athaliah
Summary: Son of Athaliah who returned with Ezra from Babylon; also named among the Levites of Ezra 8.
KeyStory: Ezra's return

Name: Jeshaiah, Son of Rehabiah

KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:21; 1 Chronicles 26:25: First of the sons of Rehabiah in the rest of the sons of Levi.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeshaiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jesharelah

LifeLesson: The mention of Jesharelah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

LifeLesson: The mention of Jeshohaiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

LifeLesson: The mention of Jeshua in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jeshua, Levite of the Return
Summary: A Levite of the line of Jeshua and Kadmiel who returned with Zerubbabel.
KeyStory: Return from exile
LifeLesson: Faithfulness in returning to rebuild is remembered by name.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile

Name: Jeshua, Priest Distributor
Summary: Jeshua served with Kore in the cities of the priests, giving portions to his brethren by courses under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Jeshua served with Kore in the cities of the priests, giving portions to his brethren by courses under Hezekiah.
RelatedPeople: Kore, Son of Imnah; King Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Fair portions for every priest, great and small, came through faithful distributors.

Name: Jeshua, Son of Azaniah
Summary: Son of Azaniah, a Levite who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
KeyStory: Covenant renewal
LifeLesson: Commitment to God is personal before it is corporate.

Name: Jeshua, Son of Jozadak
Summary: High priest who returned with Zerubbabel, rebuilt the altar, and led the laying of the temple's foundation; his sons are later found among priests who had taken foreign wives.
KeyStory: Return from exile
KeyVerses: Ezra 2:2; Ezra 3:2; Ezra 3:8; Ezra 3:9; Ezra 4:3; Ezra 5:2; Ezra 10:18; Nehemiah 12:1
LifeLesson: Worship comes first: the altar was rebuilt before the walls.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile; Rebuilding of the Temple; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall

Name: Jeshua, Son of Kadmiel
Summary: Son of Kadmiel, chief of the Levites at the dedication of the wall.
KeyStory: Dedication of the wall
LifeLesson: Leaders of song stood at the dedication.

Name: Jeshua the Levite
Summary: A Levite who taught the Law when Ezra read it, led prayer at the covenant renewal, and served among the Levite chiefs at the wall's dedication.
KeyStory: Ezra reads the law
LifeLesson: Understanding God's word is itself a ministry.
RelatedEvents: Ezra Reads the Law; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall

Name: Jesiah, Son of Uzziel
Summary: Second son of Uzziel in David's divisions.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:20; 1 Chronicles 24:24: Second son of Uzziel in David's divisions.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jesiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jesiah
Summary: One of those who came to David at Ziklag, of the Korhites.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:6: One of those who came to David at Ziklag, of the Korhites.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jesiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jesimiel
Summary: Prince of Simeon named among those whose families increased greatly.

LifeLesson: The mention of Jesimiel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jesse, Father of David
Summary: Jesse of Bethlehem was the father of David; the northern tribes' slogan in the division named David 'the son of Jesse.'
KeyStory: Jesse, father of David.
LifeLesson: A name on a list is still a life God knew.

Name: Jesse, Son of Obed
Summary: Jesse, son of Obed and grandson of Ruth, was the father of David; Ruth's genealogy ends by naming him in David's line.
KeyStory: Jesse appears in Ruth only in the closing genealogy: Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.
RelatedPeople: Obed, Son of Boaz; Boaz; Ruth; King David
LifeLesson: The genealogy ends not with a king, but with the farmer who fathered one.

Name: Jesse
Summary: Jesse of Bethlehem, son of Obed, was the father of eight sons. Samuel passed over his seven elder sons to anoint the youngest, David, as king, and Jesse later sent David with provisions to his brothers at war.
KeyStory: Jesse watched the prophet pass over seven sons to anoint the shepherd boy he had left with the sheep.
KeyVerses: 1 Samuel 16:1; 1 Samuel 16:10; 1 Samuel 16:11; 1 Samuel 17:17; 1 Samuel 22:3; 1 Chronicles 2:12; 1 Chronicles 2:13; 2 Chronicles 10:16; 2 Chronicles 11:18
RelatedPeople: King David; Eliab, Son of Jesse; Abinadab, Son of Jesse; Shammah, Son of Jesse; Obed, Son of Boaz
LifeLesson: God's choice often skips the impressive sons and rests on the overlooked one.

Name: Jesus Justus
Summary: Jesus, called Justus, was one of Paul's fellowworkers of the circumcision who were a comfort to him. He is a different man from Jesus Christ.
KeyStory: Jesus, called Justus, was one of Paul's fellowworkers of the circumcision who were a comfort to him. He is a different man from Jesus Christ.
LifeLesson: A shared name does not make a shared identity; Scripture keeps its people distinct.

Name: Jether, Father of Amasa
Summary: Jether was the father of Amasa, whom Joab slew in peacetime.
KeyStory: Jether, father of Amasa.
LifeLesson: A name on a list is still a life God knew.

Name: Jether, Father of Jephunneh
Summary: Father of Jephunneh, Pispah, and Ara in Asher's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:38: Father of Jephunneh, Pispah, and Ara in Asher's line.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jether in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Jether, Son of Ezra
Summary: Son of Ezra in Judah's genealogy.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:17: Son of Ezra in Judah's genealogy.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jether stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jether, Son of Gideon
Summary: Jether, Gideon's firstborn, was told to kill the captive kings Zebah and Zalmunna but drew not his sword, because he was yet a youth.
KeyStory: Gideon ordered Jether to slay the captive kings, but the youth feared, being yet a youth, so Gideon rose and slew them himself.
RelatedPeople: Gideon; Zebah, King of Midian; Zalmunna, King of Midian
LifeLesson: A father's hardest order fell on a son too young for it — and the father bore it himself.

Name: Jether, Son of Jada
Summary: Son of Jada who died without children.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:32: Son of Jada who died without children.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jether stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jeuel
Summary: Son of Zerah dwelling in Jerusalem, with his brethren six hundred and ninety.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:6: Son of Zerah dwelling in Jerusalem, with his brethren six hundred and ninety.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeuel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jeush, Son of Bilhan
Summary: Son of Bilhan, named among the sons of Bilhan.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:10: Son of Bilhan, named among the sons of Bilhan.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeush stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jeush, Son of Rehoboam
Summary: Jeush was a son of Rehoboam by Mahalath, daughter of Jerimoth.
KeyStory: Mahalath bore Rehoboam children: Jeush, Shamariah and Zaham.
LifeLesson: Many royal children are remembered only by name, yet each was part of the promise's line.

Name: Jeush, Son of Shimei
Summary: Son of Shimei, named among the sons of Shimei.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:10: Son of Shimei, named among the sons of Shimei.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeush stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jeuz
Summary: Son of Shaharaim by Hodesh, head of his father's house.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:10: Son of Shaharaim by Hodesh, head of his father's house.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeuz stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jezaniah, Son of Hoshaiah
Summary: Jezaniah, son of Hoshaiah, was a captain of the remnant who came with Johanan to ask Jeremiah to pray for them and learn God's will about staying or going. He is a different man from Jezaniah the Maachathite.
KeyStory: Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah came with all the captains to Jeremiah, asking him to pray that the Lord would show them the way to walk and the thing to do.
RelatedPeople: Johanan, Son of Kareah; Jeremiah; Azariah, Son of Hoshaiah
LifeLesson: Coming to ask God's will is good — but only if you will do it when it contradicts your plan.

Name: Jezaniah the Maachathite
Summary: Jezaniah the Maachathite was a captain of the forces who came with his men to Gedaliah at Mizpah after Jerusalem fell. He is a different man from Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah.
KeyStory: Jezaniah the Maachathite came with his men to Gedaliah at Mizpah and heard the governor's counsel to serve Babylon and live.
LifeLesson: After ruin, the first faithful step is to gather where God's appointed governor is.

Name: Jezebel of Thyatira
Role: Prophetess addressed in the letter to Thyatira
Summary: The letter to Thyatira addresses a woman called Jezebel who called herself a prophetess and taught and seduced Christ's servants; whether Jezebel is her name or a symbolic label for her is debated among commentators.
KeyStory: The letter to Thyatira addresses a woman called Jezebel who called herself a prophetess and taught and seduced Christ's servants; whether Jezebel is her name or a symbolic label for her is debated among commentators.
LifeLesson: False teaching inside the church is judged as seriously as persecution from outside.

Name: Jeziah, Son of Parosh
Summary: Son of Parosh named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Jeziel, Son of Azmaveth
Summary: Son of Azmaveth who came to David at Ziklag.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:3: Son of Azmaveth who came to David at Ziklag.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeziel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jezliah
Summary: Named among the sons of Elpaal in Benjamin's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:18: Named among the sons of Elpaal in Benjamin's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jezliah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jezoar
Summary: Son of Ashur by Helah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:7: Son of Ashur by Helah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jezoar stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jezrahiah
Summary: Overseer of the singers at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall (Nehemiah 12:42).
KeyStory: Dedication of the wall
LifeLesson: Singers need an overseer, and the overseer is named.

Name: Jezreel, Son of Etam
Summary: Named among the sons of the father of Etam.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:3: Named among the sons of the father of Etam.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jezreel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jezreel
Summary: Jezreel was the first child of Hosea and Gomer, named by God as a sign: the name recalled the bloodshed at Jezreel, where Jehu's dynasty began, and warned that God would break Israel's bow in the Valley of Jezreel.
KeyStory: God named Hosea's first son Jezreel, making the child's very name a warning that Israel's kingdom would fall as Jehu's house had risen — by blood.
LifeLesson: A name can be a sermon. Jezreel's name told Israel its story before he could speak a word — God writes warnings even into birth announcements.

Name: Jibsam
Summary: Son of Tola and head of his father's house, a valiant man of might.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:2: Son of Tola and head of his father's house, a valiant man of might.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jibsam stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Joab, of Pahath-moab's Family
Summary: Head of a family line listed with Jeshua under Pahath-moab among the returnees (Ezra 2:6; Nehemiah 7:11). Not Joab, David's general.
KeyStory: Return from exile
LifeLesson: A namesake centuries later is a different man, and the record keeps them distinct.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile

Name: Joab, Son of Seraiah
Summary: Son of Seraiah, called the father of the valley of Charashim, whose people were craftsmen.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:14: Son of Seraiah, called the father of the valley of Charashim, whose people were craftsmen.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Joab stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Joab, Son of Zeruiah
Summary: Joab, David's commander, slew Abner and Amasa in peacetime, fled to the altar when Solomon took the throne, and was slain there by Benaiah for the blood he had shed.
KeyStory: Joab flees to the altar and is slain by Benaiah.
RelatedPeople: King David; King Solomon; Abner, Son of Ner; Amasa, Son of Jether; Zeruiah, Mother of Joab; Zeruiah
LifeLesson: A career of victories cannot cover peacetime murders: blood returns on its own head.

Name: Joab
Summary: Joab, son of Zeruiah, commanded David's army through all his wars. He won Jerusalem, killed Abner in revenge for Asahel, murdered Amasa to keep his command, and killed Absalom against David's order. David never removed him, but charged Solomon to deal with him.
KeyStory: Joab won David's wars and murdered David's rivals — loyal, ruthless, and finally condemned.
KeyVerses: 2 Samuel 2:13; 2 Samuel 3:27; 2 Samuel 8:16; 2 Samuel 18:14; 2 Samuel 20:10; Psalm 60:1
RelatedPeople: Zeruiah; Abishai; Asahel; King David; Abner, Son of Ner; Amasa, Son of Ithra
LifeLesson: A commander who kills for revenge and ambition will answer for it, however many battles he won.

Name: Joah, Son of Asaph
Summary: Joah, son of Asaph, was Hezekiah's recorder and stood with Eliakim and Shebna before the Rabshakeh, then reported to the king with torn clothes.
KeyStory: Joah hears the Rabshakeh and reports to Hezekiah.
RelatedPeople: King Hezekiah; Eliakim, Son of Hilkiah; Shebna, Scribe; Asaph, Father of Joah
LifeLesson: The recorder's duty is to hear truly and report honestly, even threats.

Name: Joah, Son of Joahaz
Summary: Joah, son of Joahaz the recorder, was sent by Josiah with Shaphan and Maaseiah to repair the house of the LORD.
KeyStory: Josiah sent Shaphan, Maaseiah the governor, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Joahaz, Father of Joah
LifeLesson: A recorder's name is kept in the repair of the temple.

Name: Joah, Son of Obed-edom
Summary: Third son of Obed-edom the porter.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:4: Third son of Obed-edom the porter.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Joah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Joah, Son of Zimmah
Summary: Joah, son of Zimmah of the Gershonites, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah, and the father of Eden.
KeyStory: Of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah and Eden the son of Joah arose to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Eden, Son of Joah; King Hezekiah; Zimmah, Father of Joah; Zimmah, Son of Jahath
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Joah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Joah
Summary: Joah, son of Asaph, was Hezekiah's recorder and one of the three officials who met Assyria's envoys at Jerusalem's wall.
KeyStory: Joah stood with Eliakim and Shebna at the wall and asked the Rabshakeh to speak in Syrian rather than in the Jews' language, so the people on the wall would not hear.
LifeLesson: Even a minor official's careful words matter when a city is under threat.

Name: Joahaz, Father of Joah
Summary: Joahaz was the father of Joah the recorder, sent by Josiah to repair the house of the LORD.
KeyStory: Joahaz is named only as the father of Joah the son of Joahaz.
LifeLesson: A recorder's father is named in Josiah's reform.

Name: Joanna
Summary: Joanna, wife of Chuza, Herod's steward, was healed by Jesus and then travelled with Him, supporting His ministry from her own means. She was among the women who found the empty tomb and told the apostles.
KeyStory: Joanna went from Herod's household to the empty tomb, and carried the resurrection news to the apostles.
LifeLesson: Faith reaches into unlikely households. Joanna served Jesus out of Herod's court and witnessed His rising.

Name: Joash, King of Israel
Summary: Joash, son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu and king of Israel, answered Amaziah's challenge with the parable of the thistle and the cedar, defeated Judah at Beth-shemesh, broke down Jerusalem's wall, and took the temple treasures to Samaria.
KeyStory: Joash warned Amaziah to abide at home, but Amaziah would not hear, and Judah was put to the worse before Israel.
RelatedPeople: Amaziah, King of Judah; Jehoahaz, Son of Jehu
LifeLesson: Pride after a victory can provoke a defeat far worse than the first battle.

Name: Joash, King of Judah
Summary: Joash, also called Jehoash, was hidden as a baby from Athaliah's purge by his aunt Jehosheba, crowned at seven by the priest Jehoiada, and did right while Jehoiada lived, but after Jehoiada's death he turned to idolatry and was murdered by his servants.
KeyStory: Joash hidden from Athaliah, crowned by Jehoiada, and later murdered.
KeyVerses: 2 Kings 11:2; 2 Kings 12:1; 2 Kings 12:20; 2 Chronicles 22:11; 2 Chronicles 24:1; 2 Chronicles 24:2; 2 Chronicles 24:22
RelatedPeople: Jehosheba, Daughter of Jehoram; Jehoiada, High Priest; Athaliah; Zibiah, Mother of Joash; Jozachar, Son of Shimeath; Jehozabad, Son of Shomer; Jehoshabeath, Daughter of Jehoram; Jehoiada, the Priest; Zechariah, Son of Jehoiada
LifeLesson: Borrowed faith does not last: Joash was faithful under Jehoiada's guidance and fell once it was gone.

Name: Joash, Son of Ahaziah
Summary: Son of Ahaziah in the kingly line of Judah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:11: Son of Ahaziah in the kingly line of Judah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Joash stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Joash, Son of Becher
Summary: Son of Becher, named among the sons of Becher.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:8: Son of Becher, named among the sons of Becher.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Joash stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Joash, Son of Shelah's Line
Summary: Named among the ancient men of Shelah's line who had dominion in Moab.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:22: Named among the ancient men of Shelah's line who had dominion in Moab.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Joash stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Joash, Son of Shemaah
Summary: Son of Shemaah the Gibeathite who came to David at Ziklag.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:3: Son of Shemaah the Gibeathite who came to David at Ziklag.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Joash stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Joash, Steward of Oil
Summary: Over the cellars of oil of the king.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:28: Over the cellars of oil of the king.
LifeLesson: The mention of Joash in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Joash, the Abiezrite
Summary: Joash the Abiezrite, of Ophrah, was Gideon's father; when the men of the city demanded Gideon's death for breaking down Baal's altar, Joash defended him, saying Baal could plead for himself.
KeyStory: Joash owned the altar Gideon tore down, and when the townsmen came for his son, he answered that if Baal were a god he could plead his own cause — and Gideon was called Jerubbaal from that day.
LifeLesson: A father's courage can be as simple as refusing to kill his son for a god who cannot defend itself.

Name: Joash, the King's Son
Summary: Joash, the king's son at Ahab's court, was named with Amon the governor as custodian of the imprisoned prophet Micaiah.
KeyStory: Ahab ordered Micaiah carried back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king's son.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Micaiah, Son of Imla
LifeLesson: Proximity to power does not excuse silence when truth is imprisoned.

Name: Job's Wife
Summary: Job's wife is the unnamed woman who, seeing her husband covered in sores and stripped of everything, urged him to curse God and die — and was answered with steadfast faith.
KeyStory: In the depth of Job's affliction his wife spoke out of her own grief, and Job replied that they should receive good from God and trouble too, without charging God with wrong.
LifeLesson: Job's wife reminds us that grief can speak harshly, and that answering grief with steady faith is itself a kind of strength.

Name: Jobab, Son of Elpaal
Summary: Named among the sons of Elpaal in Benjamin's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:18: Named among the sons of Elpaal in Benjamin's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jobab stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Jobab, Son of Shaharaim
Summary: Son of Shaharaim by Hodesh, head of his father's house.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:9: Son of Shaharaim by Hodesh, head of his father's house.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jobab stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Joed, Son of Pedaiah
Summary: Joed son of Pedaiah, named in Nehemiah 11:7.
KeyStory: Resettling Jerusalem
LifeLesson: Every person in the record, however briefly named, belongs to God's story.

Name: Joel, Brother of Nathan
Summary: Brother of Nathan, one of David's mighty men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:38: Brother of Nathan, one of David's mighty men.
LifeLesson: The mention of Joel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Joel, Chief of Gad
Summary: Chief of the children of Gad who dwelt in Bashan.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:12: Chief of the children of Gad who dwelt in Bashan.
LifeLesson: The mention of Joel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Joel, Chief of Gershom
Summary: Chief of the sons of Gershom who brought up the ark, with his brethren an hundred and thirty.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:7; 1 Chronicles 15:11: Chief of the sons of Gershom who brought up the ark, with his brethren an hundred and thirty.
LifeLesson: The mention of Joel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Joel, Father of Shemaiah
Summary: Father of Shemaiah in Reuben's line.
