Name: Uriel, Son of Tahath
Summary: Son of Tahath and father of Uzziah in the Kohathite line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:24: Son of Tahath and father of Uzziah in the Kohathite line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uriel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Urijah, Priest
Summary: Urijah the priest built a new altar in Jerusalem after the pattern Ahaz sent from Damascus, and offered on it instead of the bronze altar, following the king's command.
KeyStory: Urijah builds Ahaz's Damascus altar.
RelatedPeople: Ahaz, King of Judah; Tiglath-Pileser, King of Assyria
LifeLesson: A priest who builds what a king sketches has traded his calling for favour.

Name: Urijah, Son of Koz
Summary: Urijah son of Koz, named in Nehemiah 3:4.
KeyStory: Rebuilding the wall
LifeLesson: Every person in the record, however briefly named, belongs to God's story.

Name: Urijah, Son of Shemaiah
Summary: Urijah, son of Shemaiah of Kirjath-jearim, prophesied against Jerusalem and the land in words like Jeremiah's. Jehoiakim sent men to Egypt, seized him, brought him back, and killed him with the sword, casting his body into the graves of the common people. He is a different man from Uriah the priest of Isaiah's day.
KeyStory: Urijah prophesied against the city, fled to Egypt when Jehoiakim sought his life, was fetched back by Elnathan, and was slain by the king.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Ahikam; Jeremiah; Elnathan
LifeLesson: A true prophet's death does not disprove his message — Ahikam's protection of Jeremiah proved the court knew it.

Name: Uthai, Son of Ammihud
Summary: Son of Ammihud son of Omri son of Imri son of Bani, of the children of Pharez son of Judah, dwelling in Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:4: Son of Ammihud son of Omri son of Imri son of Bani, of the children of Pharez son of Judah, dwelling in Jerusalem.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uthai stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Uthai
Summary: Named with Zabbud among the sons of Bigvai who returned with Ezra.
KeyStory: Ezra's return
LifeLesson: Returning to God's house is a family decision.

Name: Uzai
Summary: Father of Palal the wall builder (Nehemiah 3:25).
KeyStory: Rebuilding the wall
LifeLesson: A father's name stands behind his son's work.

Name: Uzza, Driver of the Ark
Summary: Of the house of Abinadab, who drove the cart bearing the ark and died when he put forth his hand to hold the ark.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 13:7; 1 Chronicles 13:9; 1 Chronicles 13:10: Of the house of Abinadab, who drove the cart bearing the ark and died when he put forth his hand to hold the ark.
LifeLesson: The mention of Uzza in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Uzza, Son of Gera
Summary: Son of Gera, begotten after the removal to Manahath.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:7: Son of Gera, begotten after the removal to Manahath.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uzza stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Uzza, Son of Shimei
Summary: Son of Shimei and father of Shimea in Merari's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:29: Son of Shimei and father of Shimea in Merari's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uzza stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Uzza
Summary: Nethinim (temple servant) listed among the returnees.
KeyStory: Return from exile
LifeLesson: Temple service is honourable work, even when it is lowly.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile

Name: Uzzah, Son of Abinadab
Summary: Uzzah, son of Abinadab, drove the new cart carrying the ark to Jerusalem. When the oxen stumbled at Nachon's threshingfloor, he took hold of the ark to steady it, and God struck him dead there for his error.
KeyStory: Uzzah steadied the ark with his hand — and died for touching what only priests might carry.
RelatedPeople: Abinadab of Kirjath-jearim; Ahio, Son of Abinadab; King David
LifeLesson: Good intentions do not make holy things safe to handle carelessly.

Name: Uzzi, Ancestor of Ezra
Summary: Ancestor of Ezra named in his genealogy.
KeyStory: Ezra's return
LifeLesson: A long line of priests ends in a scribe.

Name: Uzzi, Father of Elah
Summary: Father of Elah in the Jerusalem list, son of Michri.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:8: Father of Elah in the Jerusalem list, son of Michri.
LifeLesson: The mention of Uzzi in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Uzzi, Son of Bani
Summary: Uzzi son of Bani, named in Nehemiah 11:22.
KeyStory: Resettling Jerusalem
LifeLesson: Every person in the record, however briefly named, belongs to God's story.

Name: Uzzi, Son of Bela
Summary: Son of Bela and head of his father's house, a mighty man of valour.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:7: Son of Bela and head of his father's house, a mighty man of valour.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uzzi stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Uzzi, Son of Bukki
Summary: Son of Bukki and priest in Aaron's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:5; 1 Chronicles 6:51: Son of Bukki and priest in Aaron's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uzzi stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Uzzi, Son of Tola
Summary: Son of Tola and head of his father's house, a valiant man of might.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:2: Son of Tola and head of his father's house, a valiant man of might.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uzzi stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Uzzia the Ashterathite
Summary: Mighty man of David, called the Ashterathite.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:44: Mighty man of David, called the Ashterathite.
LifeLesson: The mention of Uzzia in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Uzziah, King of Judah
Summary: Uzziah, made king at sixteen, reigned fifty-two years; he sought God in the days of Zechariah, warred successfully against Philistines and Arabians, built towers and engines of war, but when strong his heart was lifted up, he burned incense in the temple, and leprosy rose in his forehead, so he lived apart as a leper until death. Also known as Azariah.
KeyStory: Azariah the priest withstood Uzziah for burning incense, and while Uzziah was wroth the leprosy rose up in his forehead before the priests.
KeyVerses: 2 Chronicles 26:1; 2 Chronicles 26:5; 2 Chronicles 26:16; 2 Chronicles 26:19; 2 Kings 15:1; 2 Kings 15:5; Isaiah 1:1; Isaiah 6:1; Isaiah 7:1; Hosea 1:1; Amos 1:1
RelatedBooks: 2 Chronicles; 2 Kings; Isaiah; Hosea; Amos; Micah
RelatedPeople: Amaziah, King of Judah; Jotham, King of Judah; Azariah, the Priest; Jecholiah, Mother of Azariah; Ahaz, King of Judah; Isaiah
LifeLesson: Strength that forgets God turns to pride, and pride into exclusion.

Name: Uzziah, Son of Harim
Summary: Son of Harim named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Uzziah, Son of Uriel
Summary: Son of Uriel and father of Shaul in the Kohathite line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:24: Son of Uriel and father of Shaul in the Kohathite line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uzziah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Uzziah, Son of Zechariah
Summary: Uzziah son of Zechariah, named in Nehemiah 11:4.
KeyStory: Resettling Jerusalem
LifeLesson: Every person in the record, however briefly named, belongs to God's story.

Name: Uzziel, of the Sons of Jeduthun
Summary: Uzziel, of the sons of Jeduthun, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel arose to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Shemaiah, of the Sons of Jeduthun; King Hezekiah; Jeduthun
LifeLesson: A clean house prepared the way for renewed praise.

Name: Uzziel, Son of Bela
Summary: Son of Bela and head of his father's house, a mighty man of valour.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:7: Son of Bela and head of his father's house, a mighty man of valour.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uzziel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Uzziel, Son of Harhaiah
Summary: Son of Harhaiah, a goldsmith who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall; a different Uzziel from Kohath's son in Exodus.
KeyStory: Rebuilding the wall
LifeLesson: A craftsman's hands can build a wall as well as a vessel.

Name: Uzziel, Son of Heman
Summary: Son of Heman the king's seer, named among his sons for song.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 25:4: Son of Heman the king's seer, named among his sons for song.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uzziel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Uzziel, Son of Ishi
Summary: Son of Ishi and captain of the five hundred Simeonites who went to Mount Seir.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:42: Son of Ishi and captain of the five hundred Simeonites who went to Mount Seir.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uzziel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Vajezatha
Summary: One of the ten sons of Haman, slain by the Jews in Shushan and afterwards hanged on the gallows.
KeyStory: Esther's deliverance
LifeLesson: A house built on hatred falls with its builder.

Name: Vaniah, Son of Bani
Summary: Son of Bani named among those who had taken foreign wives (Ezra 10:36).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Obedience sometimes costs what is dearest.

Name: Vashni
Summary: Firstborn son of Samuel, named with his brother Abiah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:28: Firstborn son of Samuel, named with his brother Abiah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Vashni stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Vashti
Summary: Queen of Ahasuerus who refused his summons to display her beauty at his feast and was deposed, opening the way for Esther.
KeyStory: Esther's deliverance
KeyVerses: Esther 1:9; Esther 1:11; Esther 1:12; Esther 1:15; Esther 1:16; Esther 1:17; Esther 1:19; Esther 2:1; Esther 2:4; Esther 2:17
LifeLesson: A refusal can change the course of a kingdom.

Name: Witch of Endor
Summary: The medium of Endor — unnamed in the text — was sought by Saul in disguise on the night before Gilboa, after God had stopped answering him. At his urging she brought up Samuel, who foretold Saul's death and Israel's defeat the next day.
KeyStory: The medium of Endor called up Samuel for a king God had stopped answering.
LifeLesson: When God is silent because of disobedience, forbidden doors still open — and what comes through them is judgment.

Name: Woman of Abel
Summary: The wise woman of Abel Beth-maachah — unnamed in the text — called to Joab from the wall while he besieged her city for Sheba's life, and bargained Sheba's head for the city's peace. Joab agreed, and the siege ended.
KeyStory: The woman of Abel bought her city's peace with a traitor's head, thrown over the wall.
LifeLesson: One wise voice on a wall can save a whole city from a siege.

Name: Woman of Tekoa
Summary: The wise woman of Tekoa — unnamed in the text — was sent by Joab to David in mourning dress with a parable about her two sons, one dead and one threatened. Her story moved David to bring Absalom back from exile.
KeyStory: The woman of Tekoa's parable of two sons moved David to recall his exiled son.
LifeLesson: A parable told by a stranger can open a king's eyes to his own house.

Name: Zabad, Son of Ahlai
Summary: Son of Ahlai, one of David's mighty men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:41: Son of Ahlai, one of David's mighty men.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zabad stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zabad, Son of Hashum
Summary: Son of Hashum named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Zabad, Son of Nathan
Summary: Son of Nathan and father of Ephlal.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:36: Son of Nathan and father of Ephlal.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zabad stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zabad, Son of Nebo
Summary: Son of Nebo named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Zabad, Son of Shimeath
Summary: Zabad, son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, was one of the servants who conspired against Joash for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada and slew him on his bed.
KeyStory: Zabad the son of Shimeath and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith conspired against Joash and slew him on his bed.
RelatedPeople: Joash, King of Judah; Shimeath, the Ammonitess
LifeLesson: Bloodshed repaid with bloodshed is the wages of a forgotten kindness.

Name: Zabad, Son of Tahath
Summary: Son of Tahath and father of Shuthelah in Ephraim's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:21: Son of Tahath and father of Shuthelah in Ephraim's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zabad stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zabad, Son of Zattu
Summary: Son of Zattu named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Zabbai, Father of Baruch
Summary: Father of Baruch, whose son repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall earnestly (Nehemiah 3:20).
KeyStory: Rebuilding the wall
LifeLesson: A son's earnest work honours his father's name.

Name: Zabbai, Son of Bebai
Summary: Son of Bebai named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Zabbud
Summary: Named with Uthai among the sons of Bigvai who returned with Ezra.
KeyStory: Ezra's return
LifeLesson: Returning to God's house is a family decision.

Name: Zabdi, Son of Asaph
Summary: Zabdi son of Asaph, named in Nehemiah 11:17.
KeyStory: Resettling Jerusalem
LifeLesson: Every person in the record, however briefly named, belongs to God's story.

Name: Zabdi, Son of Shimhi
Summary: Named among the sons of Shimhi in Benjamin's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:19: Named among the sons of Shimhi in Benjamin's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zabdi stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zabdi the Shiphmite
Summary: Shiphmite over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:27: Shiphmite over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars.
LifeLesson: The mention of Zabdi in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Zabdiel, Father of Jashobeam
Summary: Father of Jashobeam the chief captain.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:2: Father of Jashobeam the chief captain.
LifeLesson: The mention of Zabdiel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Zabdiel
Summary: Overseer of the mighty men of valour among the Jerusalem priests (Nehemiah 11:14).
KeyStory: Resettling Jerusalem
LifeLesson: Oversight of valiant men is itself service.

Name: Zabud, Son of Nathan
Summary: Zabud, son of Nathan, was Solomon's principal officer and the king's friend.
KeyStory: Zabud, principal officer and king's friend.
RelatedPeople: King Solomon; Nathan; Azariah, Son of Nathan
LifeLesson: Friendship with a king is a trust, not a prize.

Name: Zaccai
Summary: Head of a family listed among those who returned from exile.
KeyStory: Return from exile
LifeLesson: A family's return is recorded household by household.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile

Name: Zacchur, Son of Hamuel
Summary: Son of Hamuel and father of Shimei.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:26: Son of Hamuel and father of Shimei.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zacchur stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zaccur, Father of Hanan
Summary: Father of Hanan, the faithful treasurer over the storehouses (Nehemiah 13:13).
KeyStory: Dedication of the wall
LifeLesson: A faithful son reflects a father's household.

Name: Zaccur, Son of Asaph
Summary: Son of Asaph who prophesied under the hands of Asaph according to the order of the king.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 25:2; 1 Chronicles 25:10: Son of Asaph who prophesied under the hands of Asaph according to the order of the king.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zaccur stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zaccur, Son of Imri
Summary: Son of Imri who repaired part of the wall, sealed the covenant, and was made treasurer over the treasuries as a faithful man; father of Hanan.
KeyStory: Rebuilding the wall
LifeLesson: Faithfulness with accounts is faithfulness to God.

Name: Zaccur, Son of Jaaziah
Summary: Son of Jaaziah, named among the sons of Merari by Jaaziah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:27: Son of Jaaziah, named among the sons of Merari by Jaaziah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zaccur stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zachariah, Father of Abi
Summary: Zachariah was the father of Abi, mother of Hezekiah; he is distinct from Zachariah king of Israel and Zechariah the prophet.
KeyStory: Zachariah, father of Abi.
LifeLesson: A name on a list is still a life God knew.

Name: Zachariah, King of Israel
Summary: Zachariah, son of Jeroboam II, reigned six months and did evil, and was slain publicly by Shallum, ending Jehu's dynasty in its fourth generation as the LORD had spoken.
KeyStory: Zachariah slain by Shallum after six months.
RelatedPeople: Jeroboam II, King of Israel; Shallum, King of Israel
LifeLesson: God's word outlasts dynasties: Jehu's house ended exactly when He said it would.

Name: Zacher
Summary: Son of Jehiel the father of Gibeon.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:31; 1 Chronicles 9:37: Son of Jehiel the father of Gibeon.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zacher stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zadok, Ancestor of Ezra
Summary: Ancestor of Ezra named in his genealogy; a different Zadok from the wall builders of Nehemiah's day.
KeyStory: Ezra's return
LifeLesson: A long line of priests ends in a scribe.

Name: Zadok, Father of Jerushah
Summary: Zadok was the father of Jerushah, mother of King Jotham; 2 Chronicles does not state whether he is Zadok the priest of David's day.
KeyStory: Zadok is named only as the father of Jerushah, Jotham's mother.
LifeLesson: A priestly name in a mother's line hints at a godly home.

Name: Zadok, High Priest
Summary: Zadok the priest stayed loyal to David through Absalom's revolt and Adonijah's bid, anointed Solomon at Gihon, and was made priest in Abiathar's place.
KeyStory: Zadok anoints Solomon at Gihon.
RelatedPeople: King David; King Solomon; Abiathar, Priest; Nathan
LifeLesson: Loyalty through a succession crisis is remembered: Zadok stayed when others hedged.

Name: Zadok, Son of Ahitub
Summary: Zadok, son of Ahitub, was priest alongside Abiathar through David's reign. He carried the ark back to Jerusalem when David fled Absalom, refused to leave the city, and later anointed Solomon king.
KeyStory: Zadok carried the ark back into danger and stayed loyal when the kingdom split.
KeyVerses: 2 Samuel 8:17; 2 Samuel 15:24; 2 Samuel 15:29; 2 Samuel 19:11; 1 Chronicles 6:8; 1 Chronicles 6:53; 1 Chronicles 12:28
RelatedPeople: Abiathar, Son of Ahimelech; King David; Ahimaaz, Son of Zadok; Ahitub, Son of Amariah
LifeLesson: Loyalty that stays when the king flees is the loyalty that crowns the next king.

Name: Zadok, Son of Azariah
Summary: Son of Ahitub and priest in Aaron's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:12; 1 Chronicles 6:53: Son of Ahitub and priest in Aaron's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zadok stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zadok, Son of Baana
Summary: Son of Baana who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall.
KeyStory: Rebuilding the wall
LifeLesson: God's work is done by many hands, each named.

Name: Zadok, Son of Immer
Summary: Son of Immer who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall.
KeyStory: Rebuilding the wall
LifeLesson: God's work is done by many hands, each named.

Name: Zadok, Son of Meraioth
Summary: Zadok son of Meraioth, named in Nehemiah 11:11.
KeyStory: Resettling Jerusalem
LifeLesson: Every person in the record, however briefly named, belongs to God's story.

Name: Zadok the Scribe
Summary: A scribe made treasurer over the treasuries in Nehemiah's reform, counted faithful; he also sealed the covenant.
KeyStory: Covenant renewal
LifeLesson: Faithfulness with accounts is faithfulness to God.

Name: Zadok, Young Man of Valour
Summary: Young man mighty of valour who came to David at Hebron, of whose father's house were twenty and two captains.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:28: Young man mighty of valour who came to David at Hebron, of whose father's house were twenty and two captains.
LifeLesson: The mention of Zadok in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Zaham, Son of Rehoboam
Summary: Zaham was a son of Rehoboam by Mahalath, daughter of Jerimoth.
KeyStory: Mahalath bore Rehoboam children: Jeush, Shamariah and Zaham.
LifeLesson: A short record is still a real life lived before God.

Name: Zalaph
Summary: Father of Hanun the wall builder (Nehemiah 3:30).
KeyStory: Rebuilding the wall
LifeLesson: A father's name stands behind his son's work.

Name: Zalmon the Ahohite
Summary: Zalmon the Ahohite was among David's thirty mighty men.
KeyStory: Zalmon the Ahohite stood among David's thirty.
LifeLesson: An Ahohite among the thirty — the tribes fought side by side.

Name: Zalmunna, King of Midian
Summary: Zalmunna, a king of Midian, fled with Zebah from Gideon, was captured at Karkor, and was killed by Gideon.
KeyStory: Zalmunna fled with Zebah beyond Jordan, was taken at Karkor, and taunted Gideon before Gideon rose and slew them both.
RelatedPeople: Gideon; Zebah, King of Midian; Oreb, Prince of Midian; Zeeb, Prince of Midian
LifeLesson: A taunt about manhood was answered by the very man it mocked.

Name: Zattu
Summary: Head of a family listed among those who returned from exile.
KeyStory: Return from exile
LifeLesson: A family's return is recorded household by household.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile

Name: Zaza
Summary: Son of Jonathan son of Jada.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:33: Son of Jonathan son of Jada.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zaza stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zebadiah, Son of Asahel
Summary: Son of Asahel, captain after his father over the fourth month's course.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:7: Son of Asahel, captain after his father over the fourth month's course.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zebadiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zebadiah, Son of Beriah
Summary: Named among the sons of Beriah in Benjamin's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:15: Named among the sons of Beriah in Benjamin's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zebadiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zebadiah, Son of Elpaal
Summary: Named among the sons of Elpaal in Benjamin's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:17: Named among the sons of Elpaal in Benjamin's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zebadiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zebadiah, Son of Immer
Summary: A priest of the sons of Immer named among those who had taken foreign wives; a different Zebadiah from Michael's son.
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Sin named honestly is the first step back to God.

Name: Zebadiah, Son of Ishmael
Role: Ruler of the House of Judah
Summary: Zebadiah, son of Ishmael and ruler of the house of Judah, was set by Jehoshaphat over all the king's matters in the Jerusalem court.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat appointed Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king's matters.
RelatedPeople: King Jehoshaphat; Amariah, Chief Priest; Ishmael, Father of Zebadiah
LifeLesson: Civil and sacred duties both deserve faithful, courageous service.

Name: Zebadiah, Son of Jeroham
Summary: Son of Jeroham of Gedor who came to David at Ziklag.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:7: Son of Jeroham of Gedor who came to David at Ziklag.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zebadiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zebadiah, Son of Meshelemiah
Summary: Third son of Meshelemiah the porter.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:2: Third son of Meshelemiah the porter.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zebadiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zebadiah, Son of Michael
Summary: Son of Michael who returned with Ezra from Babylon; also named among priests who had taken foreign wives.
KeyStory: Ezra's return
LifeLesson: Returning well and living well are two different tests.

Name: Zebadiah, the Levite
Summary: Zebadiah was one of the Levites sent with Jehoshaphat's princes to teach the book of the law throughout Judah.
KeyStory: With the princes went Levites, including Zebadiah, and they went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught the people.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.

Name: Zebah, King of Midian
Summary: Zebah, a king of Midian, fled from Gideon, was captured at Karkor, and was killed by Gideon after Succoth and Penuel refused bread to his army.
KeyStory: Gideon pursued Zebah and Zalmunna beyond Jordan, captured them at Karkor, and killed them himself when his firstborn Jether feared to draw his sword.
RelatedPeople: Gideon; Zalmunna, King of Midian; Oreb, Prince of Midian; Zeeb, Prince of Midian
LifeLesson: Kings who mocked a small army were judged by the man they mocked.

Name: Zebedee
Role: Fisherman; Father of James and John
Summary: Zebedee was a Galilean fisherman and the father of the apostles James and John. He was mending nets with his sons when Jesus called them, and they left the boat and their father to follow Him.
KeyStory: Zebedee watched his sons walk away from the family boat to follow a travelling teacher.
RelatedPeople: James, Son of Zebedee; John the Apostle; Jesus
LifeLesson: A father's nets cannot hold sons God has called. Zebedee's loss was the church's gain.

Name: Zebina, Son of Nebo
Summary: Son of Nebo named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Zebudah, Mother of Jehoiakim
Summary: Zebudah, daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah, was the mother of Jehoiakim king of Judah.
KeyStory: Zebudah, mother of Jehoiakim.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Pedaiah, Father of Zebudah
LifeLesson: A mother from Rumah bore the king who taxed Judah for Egypt.

Name: Zebul
Summary: Zebul, ruler of Shechem under Abimelech, warned Abimelech of Gaal's revolt and drove Gaal from the city.
KeyStory: When Gaal boasted in Shechem, Zebul sent word to Abimelech, counselled him to lie in wait, and thrust Gaal out through the gate.
RelatedPeople: Abimelech, Son of Gideon; Gaal, Son of Ebed
LifeLesson: Loyalty to a bad king still served the city's order — for a time.

Name: Zechariah, Beside Ezra
Summary: Stood beside Ezra on the platform at the reading of the law (Nehemiah 8:4).
KeyStory: Ezra reads the law
LifeLesson: Standing to hear God's word is an act of reverence.

Name: Zechariah, Chief Man
Summary: A chief man sent by Ezra to Iddo at Casiphia to bring ministers for the house of God.
KeyStory: Ezra's return
LifeLesson: Leaders are sent to find servants, not only to be served.

Name: Zechariah, Father of Abijah
Summary: Zechariah was the father of Abijah, mother of King Hezekiah; 2 Chronicles does not state whether he is Zechariah who instructed Uzziah.
KeyStory: Zechariah is named only as the father of Abijah, Hezekiah's mother.
LifeLesson: A mother's father links two reigns in a single line.

Name: Zechariah, Instructor of Uzziah
Role: Instructor in the Visions of God
Summary: Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God, instructed Uzziah, and as long as Uzziah sought the LORD, God made him prosper.
KeyStory: Uzziah sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God.
LifeLesson: A king's prosperity followed his seeking God under wise instruction.

Name: Zechariah, of Iddo's Course
Summary: Head of Iddo's priestly course in the days of Joiakim (Nehemiah 12:16).
KeyStory: Dedication of the wall
LifeLesson: Every course had a head, and every head is named.

Name: Zechariah, Overseer
Summary: Zechariah, a Levite of the sons of the Kohathites, was an overseer of the workmen repairing the house of the LORD under Josiah.
KeyStory: The overseers included Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set the work forward.
LifeLesson: Kohathite overseers set the temple repair forward.

Name: Zechariah, Priest of the Ark
Summary: Priest who blew with the trumpet before the ark of God.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:24: Priest who blew with the trumpet before the ark of God.
LifeLesson: The mention of Zechariah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Zechariah, Prince of Judah
Summary: Zechariah was one of the princes Jehoshaphat sent in his third year to teach in the cities of Judah, distinct from the other Zechariahs of the book.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat sent his princes, including Zechariah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.

Name: Zechariah, Prince of Reuben
Summary: Named among the chief brethren of Reuben when their genealogy was reckoned.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:7: Named among the chief brethren of Reuben when their genealogy was reckoned.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zechariah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zechariah, Ruler of the House of God
Role: Ruler of the House of God
Summary: Zechariah, a ruler of the house of God with Hilkiah and Jehiel, gave the priests two thousand six hundred small cattle and three hundred oxen for Josiah's Passover offerings.
KeyStory: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings.
RelatedPeople: Hilkiah, the High Priest; Jehiel, Ruler of the House of God; King Josiah
LifeLesson: Rulers of God's house gave generously so the people could keep the Passover.

Name: Zechariah, Singer of Second Degree
Summary: Levite of the second degree appointed to sing with psalteries on Alamoth at the bringing up of the ark.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:18; 1 Chronicles 15:20: Levite of the second degree appointed to sing with psalteries on Alamoth at the bringing up of the ark.
LifeLesson: The mention of Zechariah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Zechariah, Son of Amariah
Summary: Zechariah son of Amariah, named in Nehemiah 11:4.
KeyStory: Resettling Jerusalem
LifeLesson: Every person in the record, however briefly named, belongs to God's story.

Name: Zechariah, Son of Asaph
Summary: Zechariah, of the sons of Asaph, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah arose to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Mattaniah, Son of Asaph; King Hezekiah; Asaph
LifeLesson: Asaph's singers also cleansed the house where they sang.

Name: Zechariah, Son of Bebai
Summary: Zechariah son of Bebai, named in Ezra 8:11.
KeyStory: Ezra's return
LifeLesson: Every person in the record, however briefly named, belongs to God's story.

Name: Zechariah, Son of Elam
Summary: Son of Elam named among those who had taken foreign wives and were called to put them away (Ezra 10).
KeyStory: Ezra's reform
LifeLesson: Repentance is specific: naming the sin is the first step to putting it away.

Name: Zechariah, Son of Hosah
Summary: Fourth son of Hosah the porter.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:11: Fourth son of Hosah the porter.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zechariah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zechariah, Son of Iddo
Summary: Prophet who, with Haggai, urged Zerubbabel and Jeshua to resume building the temple; his prophecy is dated to Darius's reign.
KeyStory: Rebuilding of the Temple
RelatedPeople: Haggai; Zerubbabel; Jeshua, Son of Jozadak
LifeLesson: God's word, not the empire's letter, gets the work moving again.

Name: Zechariah, Son of Isshiah
Summary: Son of Isshiah in the rest of the sons of Levi.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:25: Son of Isshiah in the rest of the sons of Levi.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zechariah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zechariah, Son of Jeberechiah
Summary: Zechariah, son of Jeberechiah, was one of the two faithful witnesses Isaiah took when he recorded the prophecy of Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
KeyStory: Isaiah recorded the prophecy on a great roll with Zechariah and Uriah the priest as faithful witnesses.
LifeLesson: A faithful witness does not need a large part — only a true one.

Name: Zechariah, Son of Jehoiada
Summary: Zechariah, son of Jehoiada the priest, stood above the people and warned Judah that because they had forsaken the LORD, He had forsaken them; at the king's command they stoned him in the court of the house of the LORD.
KeyStory: Zechariah cried, 'Why transgress ye the commandments of the LORD, that ye cannot prosper?' and died saying, 'The LORD look upon it, and require it.'
RelatedPeople: Jehoiada, the Priest; Joash, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Forgetting a father's kindness can lead a king to murder his friend's son.

Name: Zechariah, Son of Jehoshaphat
Summary: Zechariah was a son of Jehoshaphat who received great gifts from his father and was slain by his brother Jehoram when he took the kingdom.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat's sons, including Zechariah, were slain by Jehoram with the sword after he strengthened himself.
RelatedPeople: King Jehoshaphat; Jehoram, King of Judah
LifeLesson: A godly father's sons can still fall to a brother's ambition.

Name: Zechariah, Son of Jonathan
Summary: Zechariah son of Jonathan, named in Nehemiah 12:35.
KeyStory: Dedication of the wall
LifeLesson: Every person in the record, however briefly named, belongs to God's story.

Name: Zechariah, Son of Meshelemiah
Summary: Firstborn son of Meshelemiah the porter.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:2; 1 Chronicles 9:21: Firstborn son of Meshelemiah the porter.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zechariah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zechariah, Son of Pashur
Summary: Zechariah son of Pashur, named in Nehemiah 11:12.
KeyStory: Resettling Jerusalem
LifeLesson: Every person in the record, however briefly named, belongs to God's story.

Name: Zechariah, Son of Shiloni
Summary: Zechariah son of Shiloni, named in Nehemiah 11:5.
KeyStory: Resettling Jerusalem
LifeLesson: Every person in the record, however briefly named, belongs to God's story.

Name: Zedekiah, King of Judah
Summary: Zedekiah, born Mattaniah, was made king by Nebuchadnezzar, rebelled in his ninth year, and watched Jerusalem fall; his sons were slain before his eyes, he was blinded, and he died a prisoner in Babylon.
KeyStory: Zedekiah rebels, Jerusalem falls, and he is blinded and bound.
KeyVerses: 2 Kings 24:17; 2 Kings 25:7; 2 Chronicles 36:10; 2 Chronicles 36:12; 2 Chronicles 36:13; Jeremiah 21:1; Jeremiah 32:4-5; Jeremiah 38:14-23; Jeremiah 39:5-7
RelatedPeople: King Nebuchadnezzar; Jehoiachin, King of Judah; Hamutal, Mother of Jehoahaz and Zedekiah; Jeremiah; Jehoiakim, King of Judah; King Josiah
LifeLesson: Rebellion against God's appointed discipline ends in the very darkness Zedekiah chose.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile

Name: Zedekiah, Son of Chenaanah
Summary: Zedekiah, son of Chenaanah, made horns of iron and promised Ahab victory at Ramoth-gilead, then smote Micaiah on the cheek when Micaiah foretold disaster.
KeyStory: Zedekiah's iron horns and his blow against Micaiah.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Micaiah, Son of Imlah; Chenaanah, Father of Zedekiah the Prophet; Micaiah, Son of Imla
LifeLesson: A confident lie with iron horns is still a lie; flattery is not prophecy.

Name: Zedekiah, Son of Hananiah
Summary: Zedekiah, son of Hananiah, was a prince of Jehoiakim's court who sat in the scribe's chamber when Michaiah reported Jeremiah's roll. He is a different man from Zedekiah the king and from Zedekiah son of Maaseiah.
KeyStory: Zedekiah son of Hananiah sat among the princes in Elishama's chamber when Michaiah declared all the words of the roll.
LifeLesson: Hearing God's word in the chamber is only the beginning — what the hearers do next is the story.

Name: Zedekiah, Son of Jehoiakim
Summary: Son of Jehoiakim, named beside Jeconiah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:16: Son of Jehoiakim, named beside Jeconiah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zedekiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zedekiah, Son of Josiah
Summary: Third son of Josiah in the kingly line of Judah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:15: Third son of Josiah in the kingly line of Judah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zedekiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zedekiah, Son of Maaseiah
Summary: Zedekiah, son of Maaseiah, was a false prophet among the exiles in Babylon whom Jeremiah denounced alongside Ahab son of Kolaiah; Jeremiah foretold that Nebuchadnezzar would roast them in the fire. He is a different man from Zedekiah the king.
KeyStory: Jeremiah told the exiles that Zedekiah son of Maaseiah and Ahab son of Kolaiah, who prophesied lies, would become a curse and a byword.
RelatedPeople: Ahab, Son of Kolaiah; Jeremiah; King Nebuchadnezzar
LifeLesson: A shared lie does not halve the guilt — both prophets were named.

Name: Zeeb, Prince of Midian
Summary: Zeeb, a prince of Midian, was captured and killed by Ephraim at the winepress of Zeeb during Gideon's victory.
KeyStory: Ephraim pursued the fleeing Midianites and slew Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb, bringing the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon.
RelatedPeople: Gideon; Oreb, Prince of Midian; Zebah, King of Midian; Zalmunna, King of Midian
LifeLesson: Two princes, two landmarks: the victory was remembered in the landscape.

Name: Zelek the Ammonite
Summary: Zelek the Ammonite was among David's thirty mighty men.
KeyStory: Zelek the Ammonite stood among David's thirty.
LifeLesson: An Ammonite among the thirty — David's army crossed old borders.

Name: Zelophehad, Son of Manasseh
Summary: Second son named in Manasseh's line, who had daughters.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:15: Second son named in Manasseh's line, who had daughters.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zelophehad stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zemira
Summary: Son of Becher, named among the sons of Becher.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:8: Son of Becher, named among the sons of Becher.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zemira stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zenas
Role: Lawyer to be brought on his journey
Summary: Zenas, called the lawyer, was to be brought on his journey diligently by Titus, along with Apollos, so that nothing would be lacking to them.
KeyStory: Zenas, called the lawyer, was to be brought on his journey diligently by Titus, along with Apollos, so that nothing would be lacking to them.
LifeLesson: Care for travelling teachers, down to their provisions, is part of the church's work.

Name: Zephaniah, Father of Azariah
Summary: Father of Azariah in Heman's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:36: Father of Azariah in Heman's line.
LifeLesson: The mention of Zephaniah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Zephaniah, Second Priest
Summary: Zephaniah the second priest was taken with Seraiah after Jerusalem's fall and slain at Riblah by the king of Babylon; he is distinct from Zephaniah the prophet.
KeyStory: Zephaniah slain at Riblah.
RelatedPeople: Nebuzaradan, Captain of the Guard; Seraiah, Chief Priest
LifeLesson: Second in office, first in suffering: exile made no distinctions.

Name: Zephaniah, Son of Maaseiah
Summary: Zephaniah, son of Maaseiah, was a priest — second priest at the fall — through whom Zedekiah repeatedly sent to Jeremiah, and to whom Shemaiah the Nehelamite wrote demanding Jeremiah's imprisonment. At Jerusalem's fall he was taken to Riblah and slain. He is a different man from Zephaniah the prophet.
KeyStory: Zedekiah sent Zephaniah the priest to ask Jeremiah to pray for the city, and after the fall Nebuzaradan took Zephaniah to the king of Babylon at Riblah, where he was slain.
RelatedPeople: Jeremiah; Zedekiah, King of Judah; Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Seraiah the Chief Priest
LifeLesson: Carrying messages between a king and a prophet is a dangerous middle place — and it ends where the city's sins end.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile

Name: Zephaniah
Summary: Zephaniah, descended from King Hezekiah through Amariah, Gedaliah, and Cushi, prophesied in Judah during the reign of King Josiah. He warned of the day of the LORD against Judah's idolatry and the surrounding nations, then promised a restored, humble remnant whom God would gather and rejoice over with singing.
KeyStory: Zephaniah warned that the day of the LORD was near for Judah and the nations, then promised that God would gather a meek remnant and rejoice over them with singing.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Cushi, Father of Zephaniah; Gedaliah, Son of Amariah; Amariah, Son of Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Judgment and joy meet in Zephaniah: God confronts sin seriously, yet sings over the remnant He restores. Seek meekness now, before the day comes.

Name: Zerah, Son of Adaiah
Summary: Son of Adaiah and father of Ethni in Asaph's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:41: Son of Adaiah and father of Ethni in Asaph's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zerah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zerah, Son of Iddo
Summary: Son of Iddo and father of Jeaterai in Gershom's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:21: Son of Iddo and father of Jeaterai in Gershom's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zerah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zerah, Son of Simeon
Summary: Son of Simeon, named among the sons of Simeon.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:24: Son of Simeon, named among the sons of Simeon.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zerah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zerah, the Ethiopian
Summary: Zerah the Ethiopian came against Asa with an army of a thousand thousand and three hundred chariots, and was defeated at Mareshah when Asa cried to the LORD.
KeyStory: Asa prayed that it is nothing with the LORD to help with many or with few, and the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa.
LifeLesson: No multitude is too great for the LORD to help against, when His people rest on Him.

Name: Zerahiah, Ancestor of Ezra
Summary: Ancestor of Ezra named in his genealogy; a different Zerahiah from Elihoenai's father in Ezra 8.
KeyStory: Ezra's return
LifeLesson: A long line of priests ends in a scribe.

Name: Zerahiah, Father of Elihoenai
Summary: Father of Elihoenai, who returned with Ezra; a different Zerahiah from Ezra's ancestor.
KeyStory: Ezra's return
LifeLesson: A father's name can open a son's story.

Name: Zerahiah, Son of Uzzi
Summary: Son of Uzzi and priest in Aaron's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:6; 1 Chronicles 6:51: Son of Uzzi and priest in Aaron's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zerahiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zeresh
Summary: Wife of Haman who advised the gallows for Mordecai, then told Haman his fall before Mordecai had begun.
KeyStory: Esther's deliverance
LifeLesson: Counsel that flatters pride hastens a fall.

Name: Zereth
Summary: Son of Ashur by Helah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:7: Son of Ashur by Helah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zereth stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zeri, Son of Jeduthun
Summary: Son of Jeduthun who prophesied with a harp.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 25:3: Son of Jeduthun who prophesied with a harp.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zeri stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zeror
Summary: Zeror, son of Bechorath, is named in Saul's genealogy between Bechorath and Abiel.
KeyStory: Zeror links Bechorath's line to Abiel, Kish, and Saul.
LifeLesson: God's purposes run through generations we will never meet.

Name: Zeruah, Mother of Jeroboam
Summary: Zeruah, a widow woman, was the mother of Jeroboam, first king of Israel.
KeyStory: Zeruah, mother of Jeroboam.
LifeLesson: A name on a list is still a life God knew.

Name: Zeruiah, Mother of Joab
Summary: Zeruiah, David's sister, was the mother of Joab, commander of David's army.
KeyStory: Zeruiah, mother of Joab.
RelatedPeople: Joab, Son of Zeruiah; King David
LifeLesson: A name on a list is still a life God knew.

Name: Zeruiah
Role: Mother of Joab, Abishai and Asahel
Summary: Zeruiah is named as the mother of Joab, Abishai, and Asahel, David's three nephews and fiercest warriors. Her sister Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whom Joab murdered.
KeyStory: Zeruiah mothered the three brothers who commanded David's wars.
RelatedPeople: Joab; Abishai; Asahel; Abigail, Daughter of Nahash; Jesse
LifeLesson: A mother's sons can become a king's sword — for good and for ill.

Name: Zetham, Son of Jehiel
Summary: Son of Jehieli, over the treasures of the house of the LORD with his brother Joel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:22: Son of Jehieli, over the treasures of the house of the LORD with his brother Joel.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zetham stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zetham, Son of Laadan
Summary: Son of Laadan, named with Jehiel and Joel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:8: Son of Laadan, named with Jehiel and Joel.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zetham stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zethan
Summary: Son of Bilhan, named among the sons of Bilhan.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:10: Son of Bilhan, named among the sons of Bilhan.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zethan stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zethar
Summary: One of the seven chamberlains who served Ahasuerus at his feast.
KeyStory: Esther's deliverance
LifeLesson: Even attendants at a feast are part of the story.

Name: Zia
Summary: Named among the brethren of the house of Gad's fathers.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:13: Named among the brethren of the house of Gad's fathers.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zia stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Ziba
Summary: Ziba had been a servant of Saul's house. He told David of Mephibosheth, Jonathan's lame son, then slandered him to David during Absalom's revolt, claiming Mephibosheth hoped to regain the kingdom. David divided the land between them, and Ziba kept half.
KeyStory: Ziba first restored Mephibosheth to David's table, then slandered him for half his land.
RelatedPeople: King David; Mephibosheth, Son of Jonathan; King Saul
LifeLesson: A servant's word can restore a prince or rob him — and kings must weigh slander carefully.

Name: Zibia
Summary: Son of Shaharaim by Hodesh.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:9: Son of Shaharaim by Hodesh.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zibia stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zibiah, Mother of Joash
Summary: Zibiah of Beer-sheba was the mother of Joash, the boy king hidden from Athaliah and crowned by Jehoiada.
KeyStory: Zibiah, mother of Joash.
LifeLesson: A mother from Beer-sheba bore the king who survived a purge.

Name: Zibiah, of Beer-sheba
Summary: Zibiah of Beer-sheba was the mother of Joash, who was seven when he began to reign forty years in Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Joash's mother's name was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.
LifeLesson: The mother of a hidden king is named when his reign begins.

Name: Zichri, Father of Amasiah
Summary: Zichri was the father of Amasiah, a captain of thousands under Jehoshaphat.
KeyStory: Zichri is named only as the father of Amasiah, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.

Name: Zichri, Father of Elishaphat
Summary: Zichri was the father of Elishaphat, a captain of hundreds in Jehoiada's covenant.
KeyStory: Zichri is named only as the father of Elishaphat the son of Zichri.
LifeLesson: Three men named Zichri appear in 2 Chronicles; this one is known only as Elishaphat's father.

Name: Zichri, Father of Joel
Summary: Father of Joel the overseer, and named among the priests in Joiakim's days; a different Zichri from Izhar's son in Exodus.
KeyStory: Resettling Jerusalem
LifeLesson: A father's name can open a son's story.

Name: Zichri, Father of Micah
Summary: Father of Micah the Levite, son of Asaph.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:15: Father of Micah the Levite, son of Asaph.
LifeLesson: The mention of Zichri in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Zichri, Man of Ephraim
Summary: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king's son, Azrikam and Elkanah in Pekah's invasion of Judah.
KeyStory: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew the king's son and two of Ahaz's chief officers.
RelatedPeople: Ahaz, King of Judah; Maaseiah, Son of Ahaz
LifeLesson: Might used against brethren is recorded as slaughter, not glory.

Name: Zichri, Son of Jeroham
Summary: Named among the sons of Jeroham in Benjamin's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:27: Named among the sons of Jeroham in Benjamin's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zichri stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zichri, Son of Joram
Summary: Son of Joram in the treasurers' line by Eliezer.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:25: Son of Joram in the treasurers' line by Eliezer.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zichri stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zichri, Son of Shashak
Summary: Named among the sons of Shashak in Benjamin's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:23: Named among the sons of Shashak in Benjamin's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zichri stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zichri, Son of Shimhi
Summary: Named among the sons of Shimhi in Benjamin's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:19: Named among the sons of Shimhi in Benjamin's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zichri stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zidkijah
Summary: Priest who sealed the covenant (Nehemiah 10).
KeyStory: Covenant renewal
LifeLesson: A signature on a covenant is a public stand.

Name: Ziha
Summary: Overseer of the Nethinim dwelling in Ophel, of the Nethinim family that returned (Nehemiah 11:21; Ezra 2:43).
KeyStory: Return from exile
LifeLesson: From returning servant to overseer.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile

Name: Zilthai, Captain of Manasseh
Summary: Captain of the thousands of Manasseh who fell to David at Ziklag.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:20: Captain of the thousands of Manasseh who fell to David at Ziklag.
LifeLesson: The mention of Zilthai in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Zilthai
Summary: Named among the sons of Shimhi in Benjamin's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:20: Named among the sons of Shimhi in Benjamin's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zilthai stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zimmah, Father of Joah
Summary: Zimmah was the father of Joah, a Gershonite Levite who cleansed the temple under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Zimmah is named only as the father of Joah the son of Zimmah.
LifeLesson: A Gershonite line is traced father to son.

Name: Zimmah, Son of Jahath
Summary: Son of Jahath and father of Joah in Gershom's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:20: Son of Jahath and father of Joah in Gershom's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zimmah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zimmah, Son of Shimei
Summary: Son of Shimei and father of Ethan in Asaph's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:42: Son of Shimei and father of Ethan in Asaph's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zimmah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zimri, King of Israel
Summary: Zimri, captain of half Elah's chariots, slew Elah and all Baasha's house, reigned seven days in Tirzah, and when Omri besieged him burned the king's house over himself and died.
KeyStory: Zimri's seven-day reign ends in fire.
RelatedPeople: Elah, King of Israel; Omri, King of Israel
LifeLesson: Seven days of power bought by murder is no reign at all.

Name: Zimri, Son of Jehoadah
Summary: Son of Jehoadah and father of Moza.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:36; 1 Chronicles 9:42: Son of Jehoadah and father of Moza.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zimri stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zimri, Son of Zerah
Summary: Son of Zerah, named among the five sons of Zerah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:6: Son of Zerah, named among the five sons of Zerah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zimri stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zina
Summary: Son of Shimei, named among the sons of Shimei.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:10: Son of Shimei, named among the sons of Shimei.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zina stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Ziph, Son of Jehaleleel
Summary: Son of Jehaleleel in Judah's genealogy.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:16: Son of Jehaleleel in Judah's genealogy.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ziph stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Ziphah
Summary: Son of Jehaleleel in Judah's genealogy.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:16: Son of Jehaleleel in Judah's genealogy.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ziphah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Ziza, Son of Rehoboam
Summary: Ziza was a son of Rehoboam by Maachah, daughter of Absalom.
KeyStory: Maachah bore Rehoboam Abijah, Attai, Ziza and Shelomith.
LifeLesson: Every name in the record belonged to a person God knew.

Name: Ziza, Son of Shiphi
Summary: Son of Shiphi son of Allon son of Jedaiah son of Shimri son of Shemaiah, prince of Simeon.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:37: Son of Shiphi son of Allon son of Jedaiah son of Shimri son of Shemaiah, prince of Simeon.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ziza stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zizah
Summary: Second son of Jahath, named in the Gershonite reckoning.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:11: Second son of Jahath, named in the Gershonite reckoning.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zizah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zobebah
Summary: Son of Coz, named in Judah's genealogy.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:8: Son of Coz, named in Judah's genealogy.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zobebah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zoheth
Summary: Son of Ishi in Judah's genealogy.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:20: Son of Ishi in Judah's genealogy.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zoheth stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zophah
Summary: Son of Helem in Asher's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:35: Son of Helem in Asher's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zophah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zophai
Summary: Son of Elkanah and father of Nahath in the Samuel line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:26: Son of Elkanah and father of Nahath in the Samuel line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zophai stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Zuph, Father of Toah
Summary: Father of Toah and son of Elkanah in Heman's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:35: Father of Toah and son of Elkanah in Heman's line.
LifeLesson: The mention of Zuph in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.

Name: Zuph
Summary: Zuph is named as the forefather of Elkanah's line, the Ephrathite family from which Samuel came.
KeyStory: Zuph stands at the head of the short genealogy that introduces Elkanah, Samuel's father.
LifeLesson: God often begins great stories with families the world has never heard of.

Name: Zur, Son of Jehiel
Summary: Son of Jehiel the father of Gibeon.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:30; 1 Chronicles 9:36: Son of Jehiel the father of Gibeon.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zur stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.

Name: Abaddon
Summary: Abaddon is the angel of the bottomless pit named in Revelation 9:11. The verse gives both names: in Hebrew Abaddon, in Greek Apollyon, both meaning destroyer or destruction. This is one figure under two names, not two figures, and the text does not identify him with Satan.
KeyStory: The fifth trumpet
LifeLesson: Judgment is real, and it is measured.

Name: Angel of the LORD
Summary: The Angel of the LORD appears across the Old Testament — to Hagar in the wilderness, to Abraham on Moriah, to Moses at the burning bush, to Gideon, to Manoah's wife, and to Jerusalem in Hezekiah's day — often speaking in the first person as God himself. Whether these appearances are a theophany, or the pre-incarnate Christ (a Christophany), is debated by scholars and theologians; this profile states the appearances and the debate without settling it.
KeyStory: The LORD's messenger appears
KeyVerses: Genesis 16:7; Genesis 22:11; Exodus 3:2; Judges 6:11; Judges 13:3; 2 Kings 19:35
RelatedPeople: Hagar; Abraham; Moses; Gideon; Manoah, Father of Samson
LifeLesson: God comes close to people in their fear and failure.

Name: Elam, the Singer
Summary: Elam was one of the singers at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall, listed with Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, and Ezer. NOTE ON IDENTITY: this singer is not the Elam son of Shem of Genesis 10; the text does not connect them, so this is a separate profile for the Nehemiah 12:42 singer only.
KeyStory: Singers at the dedication
LifeLesson: Rebuilt walls are dedicated with singing.

Name: Eleazar, the Singer
Summary: Eleazar was one of the singers at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall, listed with Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Elam, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, and Ezer. NOTE ON IDENTITY: this singer is not Eleazar son of Aaron or any other Eleazar in the text; the text does not identify him further, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 12:42 singer.
KeyStory: Singers at the dedication
LifeLesson: Rebuilt walls are dedicated with singing.

Name: Gabriel
Summary: Gabriel is the angel who explains Daniel's visions and who announces the births of John the Baptist and of Jesus. Daniel calls him 'the man Gabriel'; Luke calls him the angel who stands in the presence of God. Nothing beyond these biblical appearances is asserted here.
KeyStory: Announcing John and Jesus
RelatedPeople: Daniel; Zechariah, Father of John the Baptist; Mary, Mother of Jesus
LifeLesson: God's messages come to ordinary people in ordinary places.

Name: Hananiah, Sealer of the Covenant
Summary: Hananiah was among the chiefs who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's day, listed with Hosea, Hashub, and others. NOTE ON IDENTITY: the text does not say whether this Hananiah is any other Hananiah in the text, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 10:23 sealer and does not merge him with any other Hananiah.
KeyStory: Sealing the covenant
LifeLesson: A sealed covenant is a promise put in writing.

Name: Hilkiah, Priest of Jeshua's Days
Summary: Hilkiah was a priestly course head in the days of Jeshua son of Jozadak. NOTE ON IDENTITY: this Hilkiah is not identified in the text with Hilkiah the high priest of Josiah's day or any other Hilkiah, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 12:7 course head.
KeyStory: Priests in Jeshua's days
LifeLesson: The courses of priests kept worship ordered across generations.

Name: Iddo, Priest of Jeshua's Days
Summary: Iddo was a priestly course head in the days of Jeshua son of Jozadak. NOTE ON IDENTITY: this Iddo is not identified in the text with Iddo the grandfather of Zechariah the prophet or any other Iddo, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 12:4 course head.
KeyStory: Priests in Jeshua's days
LifeLesson: The courses of priests kept worship ordered across generations.

Name: Julius, the Centurion
Summary: Julius was the centurion of Augustus' band who had Paul in charge on the voyage to Rome. He treated Paul kindly, letting him visit friends at Sidon, and when the ship wrecked he stopped the soldiers from killing the prisoners so that Paul would be saved.
KeyStory: Paul's voyage to Rome
LifeLesson: Kindness from an unexpected quarter can save lives.

Name: Maaseiah, Sealer of the Covenant
Summary: Maaseiah was among the chiefs who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's day, listed with Rehum and Hashabnah. NOTE ON IDENTITY: the text does not say whether this Maaseiah is the priest who stood by Ezra and sang at the wall's dedication, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 10:25 sealer and does not merge him with any other Maaseiah.
KeyStory: Sealing the covenant
LifeLesson: A sealed covenant is a promise put in writing.

Name: Meremoth, Priest of Jeshua's Days
Summary: Meremoth was a priestly course head in the days of Jeshua son of Jozadak. NOTE ON IDENTITY: a priest named Meremoth son of Uriah appears in Ezra and Nehemiah's wall and covenant lists; the text does not say whether the course head of Nehemiah 12:3 is that man, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 12:3 course head and does not merge them.
KeyStory: Priests in Jeshua's days
LifeLesson: The courses of priests kept worship ordered across generations.

Name: Meshullam, the Porter
Summary: Meshullam was one of the porters at the temple gates in Nehemiah's day, listed with Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Talmon, and Akkub. NOTE ON IDENTITY: several men named Meshullam appear in Ezra and Nehemiah; the text does not say whether this porter is one of them, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 12:25 porter and does not merge him with any other Meshullam.
KeyStory: Porters at the gates
LifeLesson: Faithful gatekeeping is faithful service.

Name: Michael
Summary: Michael is called 'one of the chief princes' in Daniel, 'the archangel' in Jude, where he disputes with the devil over the body of Moses, and the leader of heaven's army against the dragon in Revelation. No role beyond these biblical passages is asserted here.
KeyStory: War in heaven
LifeLesson: God's people are fought for, not left to fight alone.

Name: Nathanael
Summary: Nathanael of Cana in Galilee was brought to Jesus by Philip, confessed him as the Son of God and King of Israel, and was among the seven disciples at the Sea of Tiberias after the resurrection. Tradition identifies Nathanael with the apostle Bartholomew (named in the apostolic lists where Nathanael is not); this profile keeps them separate and notes the tradition without merging them.
KeyStory: Come and see
LifeLesson: Honest doubt, brought to Jesus, becomes honest faith.

Name: Pharaoh-nechoh
Summary: Pharaoh-nechoh, also called Neco, was king of Egypt when Judah's last kings fell. He killed King Josiah at Megiddo, deposed Jehoahaz after three months, and set up Jehoiakim as a tributary king. He is the pharaoh Jeremiah names in the oracle against Egypt at Carchemish.
KeyStory: Josiah's death at Megiddo
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Jehoahaz, King of Judah; Jehoiakim, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Even great kings fall when they fight battles God did not send them to.

Name: Pharaoh
Summary: Pharaoh is the title of Egypt's king, not one man. The Bible follows the office across episodes: the pharaoh who took Sarah in Abraham's day, the pharaoh who raised Joseph and then the pharaoh who enslaved Israel, the pharaoh of the Exodus who hardened his heart against Moses, and later pharaohs such as Solomon's father-in-law. Most holders are unnamed in the text. Popular identifications of the Exodus pharaoh (for example Ramesses II or Merneptah) are scholarly proposals, not statements of the text, and are not asserted here. Named Egyptian kings in the text — So, Pharaoh-nechoh, and Hophra — have their own profiles.
KeyStory: Pharaohs across the story
KeyVerses: Genesis 12:15; Genesis 41:1; Exodus 5:1; Exodus 14:8; 1 Kings 3:1; 1 Kings 9:16
RelatedPeople: Abraham; Joseph, Son of Jacob; Moses; Aaron; King Solomon
LifeLesson: Power that forgets God ends by fighting him.
RelatedEvents: The Ten Plagues; The Exodus and the Red Sea

Name: Salome, Daughter of Herodias
Summary: The daughter of Herodias is unnamed in the Gospels: Matthew and Mark say only that Herodias's daughter danced before Herod and, prompted by her mother, asked for John the Baptist's head on a charger. The name Salome comes from the historian Josephus, not from the Gospel text, and is stated here as tradition, not as a biblical name.
KeyStory: John the Baptist's death
RelatedPeople: Herodias; Herod Antipas; John the Baptist
LifeLesson: A moment's dance can carry a lifetime's guilt — be careful what you ask for.

Name: Samgar-nebo
Summary: Samgar-nebo was one of the princes of the king of Babylon who sat in the middle gate when Jerusalem fell. NOTE ON IDENTITY: it is unclear whether 'Samgar-nebo' is a personal name, a title, or a combination; the text gives no further information, so this profile records the name exactly as the King James text gives it, with the uncertainty stated, and asserts nothing further about him.
KeyStory: Jerusalem falls
LifeLesson: Some names in Scripture come with no story attached — and are recorded anyway.

Name: Satan
Summary: Satan, the adversary, appears as the accuser in Job, as the accuser of Joshua the high priest in Zechariah, as the tempter of Jesus, as the one who desired to sift Peter, and as the dragon of Revelation, called 'that old serpent, the Devil, and Satan.' His other biblical titles are noted here, not given separate profiles: 'Devil' is the same figure; 'Lucifer' in Isaiah 14:12 is traditionally applied to him, but that identification is debated and is not presented as settled; 'Beelzebub' is a title traditionally associated with him. This profile covers the named adversary from Job onward; the identification of the Genesis serpent with Satan is traditional and is noted as such, not asserted from Genesis itself.
KeyStory: The adversary across the canon
KeyVerses: Job 1:6; Zechariah 3:1; Matthew 4:1; Luke 22:31; Revelation 12:9; Revelation 20:2
RelatedPeople: Job; Jesus; Simon Peter; Judas Iscariot
LifeLesson: The accuser's power is real, but it is bounded — and it loses.

Name: Shemaiah, of the First Company
Summary: Shemaiah went in the first company at the dedication procession, with Judah, Benjamin, and Jeremiah. NOTE ON IDENTITY: several men named Shemaiah appear in Nehemiah; the text does not say whether this is the Shemaiah of the covenant sealers or the dedication singers, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 12:34 company leader and does not merge him with any other Shemaiah.
KeyStory: The dedication procession
RelatedPeople: Judah the Levite; Jeremiah the Musician
LifeLesson: Worship goes first, in ordered ranks.

Name: Shemaiah, Priest of Jeshua's Days
Summary: Shemaiah was a priestly course head in the days of Jeshua son of Jozadak, listed with Joiarib and Jedaiah. NOTE ON IDENTITY: several men named Shemaiah appear in Nehemiah; the text does not say whether this course head is the Shemaiah of the covenant, the dedication singers, or the first company, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 12:6 course head and does not merge him with any other Shemaiah.
KeyStory: Priests in Jeshua's days
RelatedPeople: Jeshua, Son of Jozadak; Joiarib, Father of Jedaiah
LifeLesson: The courses of priests kept worship ordered across generations.

Name: Shulamite
Summary: The Shulamite is the bride addressed in the Song of Solomon. No personal name is given for her in the text; 'Shulamite' is the title by which she is called. This is a titled profile for an unnamed-but-identifiable person, not a named individual.
KeyStory: The Song's bride
KeyVerses: Song of Solomon 6:13; Song of Solomon 7:1
LifeLesson: Love that is named by a title, not a name, is still fully known.

Name: Zadok, Sealer of the Covenant
Summary: Zadok was among the chiefs who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's day, listed with Meshezabeel and Jaddua. NOTE ON IDENTITY: the text does not say whether this Zadok is Zadok the scribe or any other Zadok, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 10:21 sealer and does not merge him with any other Zadok.
KeyStory: Sealing the covenant
LifeLesson: A sealed covenant is a promise put in writing.

KeyStory: Josiah's reform
LifeLesson: Josiah's reform reached even the horses by the temple gate — no corner of idolatry was left alone.
Name: Nathan-melech
Summary: Nathan-melech was a chamberlain whose chamber stood at the entering in of the house of the LORD, where horses dedicated to the sun were kept. King Josiah took those horses away and burned the chariots of the sun with fire as part of his reform. He is named only once, and nothing further is recorded about him.
